en.t: The Concordat of Worms settles an imperial dispute
en.s: Emperor Henry V and Pope Callixtus II reached an agreement at Worms to resolve their dispute over the appointment of bishops and abbots. The settlement separated spiritual investiture from the granting of secular authority. Henry gave up the use of the ring and staff to confer religious office, while retaining a role in elections and the transfer of associated lands. The compromise brought the imperial phase of the Investiture Controversy to an end. It did not remove every tension between rulers and the Church, but established a lasting distinction between their responsibilities in making ecclesiastical appointments.
en.n: September 23 follows the historical calendar convention of the source.

zh.t: 沃尔姆斯宗教协定解决皇帝与教会的争端
zh.s: 皇帝亨利五世与教皇卡利克斯图斯二世在沃尔姆斯达成协议，解决主教和修道院院长任命权之争。协议将宗教授职与世俗权力授予区分开来。亨利放弃以戒指和权杖授予宗教职务，但仍保留参与选举以及转让相关地产的权力。这项妥协结束了叙任权之争中的帝国阶段。它没有消除统治者与教会之间的所有矛盾，却确立了双方在教会职务任命中的职责区别，并产生长远影响。

zh.s: 阿尔托帕肖战役于1325年在托斯卡纳爆发，交战双方是卡斯特鲁乔·卡斯特拉卡尼率领的卢卡吉伯林派军队和佛罗伦萨归尔甫派军队。

en.t: French ships defeat an English wool convoy at Arnemuiden
en.s: A French fleet attacked five English merchant ships carrying wool near Arnemuiden, a port in what is now the Netherlands. The cargo was intended for sale in Antwerp to help finance Edward III's continental alliances. Outnumbered, the English squadron eventually surrendered, and the French captured its ships and goods. The engagement was an early naval encounter of the Hundred Years' War. It is also noted for the presence of guns aboard the English ship Christopher, an early documented use of artillery in European naval fighting. Accounts of the battle describe the killing of captured English sailors.
en.n: The date follows the historical calendar convention of the source.

zh.t: 法军在阿纳姆登附近击败英格兰羊毛船队
zh.s: 法国舰队在阿纳姆登附近袭击了5艘运载羊毛的英格兰商船。羊毛原本要运往安特卫普出售，为爱德华三世在欧洲大陆结盟筹措资金。英格兰船队寡不敌众，最终投降；法军缴获了船只和货物。这场交战是百年战争早期的一次海战。英格兰船“克里斯托弗”号上配有火炮，也因此成为欧洲海战中早期使用火炮的有据可查案例之一。关于这场战斗的记载还提到，英格兰水手被俘后遭到杀害。

zh.s: 1408年9月23日，列日市民与无畏者约翰率领的职业军队交战。列日民兵遭到惨败。

en.s: The Battle of Sellnitz was fought on 23 September 1438 between the Imperial Saxons and the Hussites. The Saxons were led by Frederick II of Saxony. On his journey to Saxony from Bohemia was accompanied by czech noble Jakoubek of Vřesovice, the former hussite leader (hetman) of the Union of Žatec and Louny, now hetman of the region Litoměřice and Žatec.

zh.t: 塞尔尼茨战役
zh.s: 1438年9月23日，帝国萨克森军队与胡斯派交战。萨克森军队由腓特烈二世率领。他从波希米亚返回萨克森时，捷克贵族雅库贝克·德日热索维采同行；雅库贝克曾是扎泰茨和卢尼联盟的胡斯派首领，当时任利托梅日采和扎泰茨地区的军事首领。

en.t: The Yorkists win the Battle of Blore Heath
en.s: An army led by the Earl of Salisbury defeated a Lancastrian force at Blore Heath in Staffordshire. Salisbury was marching from northern England to join other Yorkist forces when troops commanded by Lord Audley attempted to intercept him. The encounter ended the uneasy peace that had followed the earlier fighting at St Albans. Audley was killed, and the Yorkists continued their march, although their victory did not settle the struggle for the crown. The battle became one of the major early engagements of the Wars of the Roses, the dynastic conflicts between supporters of the houses of Lancaster and York.
en.n: The date follows the historical calendar convention of the source.

zh.t: 约克派在布洛尔希思战役中获胜
zh.s: 索尔兹伯里伯爵率军在斯塔福德郡的布洛尔希思击败兰开斯特派军队。当时他正从英格兰北部南下，准备与其他约克派部队会合，奥德利勋爵率军试图拦截。战斗打破了第一次圣奥尔本斯战役后短暂而脆弱的和平。奥德利阵亡，约克派继续行军，但这场胜利并未结束王位争夺。布洛尔希思战役成为玫瑰战争早期的重要战役之一；玫瑰战争是兰开斯特家族与约克家族支持者之间的王朝冲突。

en.t: King Philip II of Spain issues cedula, ordering a halt to colonizing efforts in Florida
en.s: Philip II (21 May 1527 – 13 September 1598), sometimes known in Spain as Philip the Prudent (Spanish: Felipe el Prudente), was King of Spain from 1556, King of Portugal from 1580, and King of Naples and Sicily from 1554 until his death in 1598. He was also jure uxoris King of England and Ireland from his marriage to Queen Mary I in 1554 until her death in 1558.

zh.t: 西班牙国王腓力二世颁布敕令，要求停止在佛罗里达的殖民活动
zh.s: 腓力二世（1527年5月21日—1598年9月13日），在西班牙有时称“谨慎者腓力”（西班牙语：Felipe el Prudente），自1556年起担任西班牙国王，1580年起兼任葡萄牙国王，1554年至1598年去世前统治那不勒斯和西西里。他还因与玛丽一世女王结婚，于1554年至1558年担任英格兰和爱尔兰国王。

en.s: The Battle of Ardnaree, was a battle in the Tudor conquest of Ireland fought at Ardnaree (now a suburb of Ballina, County Mayo) on 23 September 1586. The result was a victory for the English over the Mac Philbins and Burkes. The conflict was a part of the political and military struggle, involving the English and occasionally the Scots, for control of northern Ireland.Ardnaree the anglicised version of the name can be translated to Árd na ríogh meaning the hill of the kings. The Mac Philbins and Mayo Burkes were in rebellion against the brutal English rule.

zh.t: 阿德纳里战役
zh.s: 都铎王朝征服爱尔兰期间，英军于1586年9月23日在阿德纳里（今梅奥郡巴利纳郊区）击败麦克·菲尔宾家族和伯克家族。双方冲突属于争夺爱尔兰北部控制权的政治和军事斗争，英格兰军队有时也得到苏格兰方面协助。“阿德纳里”是当地名称的英语化写法，据称源自Árd na ríogh，意为“国王之丘”。麦克·菲尔宾家族和梅奥伯克家族反抗当时残酷的英国统治。

en.s: The siege of Troitsky monastery (Russian: Троицкая осада) was an abortive attempt of the Polish–Lithuanian irregular army (mercenaries) that acted in support of False Dmitry II to capture the Trinity Lavra of St. Sergius, north-east of Moscow. The siege lasted for 16 months, from 23 September 1608 until 12 January 1610.

zh.t: 特罗伊茨基修道院围城战
zh.s: 波兰—立陶宛雇佣兵支持假德米特里二世，试图攻占莫斯科东北方向的谢尔盖圣三一修道院。这场围城从1608年9月23日持续到1610年1月12日，共16个月，最终未能攻下修道院。

en.t: Royalist cavalry wins at Powick Bridge
en.s: Royalist and Parliamentarian mounted troops clashed south of Worcester during the opening campaign of the English Civil War. Prince Rupert's men had been sent to assist a Royalist convoy carrying valuables, while their opponents hoped to intercept it. When the Parliamentarian force approached, Royalist dragoons and cavalry rapidly formed for battle and drove it back. A rearguard at Powick Bridge helped cover the retreat. The Royalists subsequently left Worcester with their convoy. Though small compared with later battles, the encounter was the first engagement between elements of the principal field armies and helped establish Rupert's reputation as a cavalry commander.
en.n: September 23 is the Julian-calendar date used in contemporary England.

zh.t: 保王党骑兵在波威克桥战役中获胜
zh.s: 英国内战初期，保王党和议会派骑兵在伍斯特以南交战。鲁珀特亲王率部前去支援一支运送贵重物品的保王党车队，议会派则试图拦截。议会派军队逼近后，保王党龙骑兵和骑兵迅速列阵，将对方击退。波威克桥附近的后卫部队掩护了撤退。此后，保王党带着车队离开伍斯特。与后来的大战相比，这次交战规模不大，却是双方主力野战军首次交锋，也让鲁珀特以善用骑兵闻名。
zh.n: 9月23日为当时英格兰使用的儒略历日期。

en.s: The Battle of Pyliavtsi (Ukrainian: Битва під Пилявцями, Polish: Bitwa pod Piławcami; 21–23 September 1648) was the third significant battle of the Khmelnytsky Uprising. Near the site of the present-day village of Pyliava in Ukraine, a forces of the Zaporozhian Host and Crimean Khanate under the command of Hetman Bohdan Khmelnytsky, Otaman Tymofiy Khmelnytsky, Colonel Maksym Kryvonis and Tugay Bey attacked and decisively defeated the Polish–Lithuanian Commonwealth’s forces under the command of Princes Władysław Dominik Zasławski-Ostrogski and Jeremi Wiśniowiecki, Noblemans Mikołaj Ostroróg and Aleksander Koniecpolski with Magnate Janusz Tyszkiewicz.

zh.t: 皮利亚夫齐战役
zh.s: 1648年9月21日至23日，赫梅利尼茨基起义期间发生了第三场重要战役——皮利亚夫齐战役。波格丹·赫梅利尼茨基赫特曼、其子季莫菲·赫梅利尼茨基、上校马克西姆·克里沃尼斯和图盖贝伊率领扎波罗热哥萨克与克里米亚汗国军队，在今乌克兰皮利亚瓦村附近进攻并决定性击败波兰立陶宛联邦军队。对方将领包括瓦迪斯瓦夫·扎斯瓦夫斯基-奥斯特罗格斯基亲王、耶雷米·维希涅维茨基亲王、贵族米科瓦伊·奥斯特鲁鲁格和亚历山大·科涅茨波尔斯基，以及扬努什·季什凯维奇。

zh.s: 第一次明斯特战争是荷兰共和国与明斯特采邑主教国之间的一场短期冲突，英格兰支持明斯特一方。该冲突与第二次英荷战争有关。

en.t: A disputed treaty follows Russia's campaign against Persia
en.s: Persian envoy Ismail Beg signed an agreement in Saint Petersburg following Russia's campaign around the Caspian Sea. Its terms assigned Russia territories including Derbent, Baku, and several northern Iranian provinces, in exchange for promised military support for Shah Tahmasp II. The shah subsequently refused to ratify the agreement, so its signing should not be described as an uncontested settlement accepted by both rulers. The episode reflected the severe weakening of Safavid authority and Russian attempts to expand southward. Russia later returned the acquired territories through agreements concluded in the 1730s, as Iranian power recovered under the rising military leader Nader.
en.n: September 23 Gregorian corresponds to September 12 in the Julian calendar.

zh.t: 俄罗斯远征波斯后签订一份有争议的条约
zh.s: 波斯使节伊斯梅尔·贝格在圣彼得堡签署协议，结束俄罗斯围绕里海地区的军事行动。协议约定，波斯割让杰尔宾特、巴库及伊朗北部数省，俄罗斯则承诺支持塔赫玛斯普二世国王。但国王后来拒绝批准协议，因此不能把签署说成两位统治者都接受的最终和约。这一事件反映了萨法维王朝权力严重衰弱，也体现了俄罗斯向南扩张的企图。伊朗实力在纳迪尔崛起后恢复，俄罗斯于1730年代通过后续协议归还了占领的领土。
zh.n: 公历9月23日对应儒略历9月12日。

loc: 弗兰伯勒角外海（约克郡海岸）

en.t: John Paul Jones's squadron fights off Flamborough Head
en.s: A squadron commanded by Continental Navy captain John Paul Jones encountered British warships protecting a merchant convoy off the Yorkshire coast. In a prolonged engagement, Jones's Bonhomme Richard fought the better-armed Serapis at close quarters. The British escort vessels were eventually captured, but Bonhomme Richard was so badly damaged that it later sank. Most of the merchant convoy escaped while its escorts fought. The action became one of the best-known naval episodes of the American Revolutionary War. Its location off Britain also demonstrated the conflict's Atlantic reach and the importance of French ships and sailors to Jones's operations.

zh.t: 约翰·保罗·琼斯的舰队在弗兰伯勒角海战中击退英军
zh.s: 大陆海军舰长约翰·保罗·琼斯率领的舰队在约克郡海岸附近遇上护送商船队的英国军舰。战斗持续很久，琼斯的“好人理查德”号与火力更强的“塞拉皮斯”号近距离交战。英国护航舰最终被俘，但“好人理查德”号受损严重，后来沉没。商船队大多趁护航舰交战时逃脱。这场海战成为美国独立战争中最著名的海战之一。战场位于英国近海，也显示了战争延伸至大西洋，以及法国船只和水手对琼斯行动的重要性。

en.t: John André's capture exposes the West Point conspiracy
en.s: American militiamen stopped British officer John André near Tarrytown, New York, while he was returning from a secret meeting with Benedict Arnold. Papers found on André revealed plans connected with Arnold's intended surrender of the strategically important American post at West Point. The discovery exposed the conspiracy before the transfer could take place. Arnold escaped to British protection, while André was taken into American custody and tried as a spy. His execution followed in October, rather than on the day of his capture. The episode became a defining case of espionage and betrayal during the American Revolutionary War.

zh.t: 约翰·安德烈被捕，西点要塞叛变阴谋败露
zh.s: 美国民兵在纽约州塔里敦拦下英国军官约翰·安德烈。当时他刚与本尼迪克特·阿诺德秘密会面，正准备返回。安德烈身上搜出的文件揭露了与阿诺德有关的计划：阿诺德打算把具有重要战略意义的西点要塞交给英军。阴谋在交接前败露。阿诺德逃到英军一方，安德烈则被美军拘押，并以间谍罪受审。他于10月被处决，并非在被捕当天。此事成为美国独立战争中间谍活动与叛变的代表事件。

loc: 阿萨耶（今印度马哈拉施特拉邦）

en.t: Wellesley's army defeats Maratha forces at Assaye
en.s: Arthur Wellesley led an East India Company army against Maratha forces near Assaye in western India. Although outnumbered, he decided to attack before joining another British force operating nearby. Maratha artillery inflicted heavy losses, but infantry and cavalry attacks eventually compelled the defending army to withdraw. Wellesley's exhausted troops could not mount an effective pursuit. The battle was a major engagement of the Second Anglo-Maratha War and an important early victory for the future Duke of Wellington. Alongside subsequent campaigns, it contributed to the expansion of British power in India at the expense of the Maratha confederacy.

zh.t: 韦尔斯利率军在阿萨耶战役中击败马拉塔军
zh.s: 阿瑟·韦尔斯利率领东印度公司军队，在印度西部阿萨耶附近与马拉塔军交战。虽然敌军人数更多，他仍决定在另一支英军赶到会合前发动进攻。马拉塔军的炮火造成英军重大伤亡，但步兵和骑兵的进攻最终迫使守军撤退。韦尔斯利的部队已十分疲惫，没能有效追击。这是第二次英马拉塔战争中的一场重要战役，也是后来成为威灵顿公爵的韦尔斯利早期的一次重要胜利。此后的一系列战事推动英国在印度扩张势力，马拉塔联盟则逐步失势。

en.t: The Corps of Discovery returns to St. Louis
en.s: The expedition led by Meriwether Lewis and William Clark returned to St. Louis after traveling across western North America to the Pacific and back. Commissioned by President Thomas Jefferson following the Louisiana Purchase, the Corps of Discovery gathered information about waterways, landscapes, plants, animals, and Indigenous nations. Its members relied on local knowledge, trade, and assistance from Native communities, including the interpreting work associated with Sacagawea. They brought back journals, maps, and specimens that expanded American geographic knowledge. The expedition also served United States territorial ambitions; the lands it described were already inhabited, rather than an empty wilderness awaiting discovery.

zh.t: 发现军团返回圣路易斯
zh.s: 刘易斯和克拉克率领的远征队横穿北美西部、抵达太平洋后返回圣路易斯。美国总统托马斯·杰斐逊在路易斯安那购地后委派了这次远征。发现军团沿途记录水道、地貌、动植物和原住民族群的信息；队员依靠当地知识、贸易和原住民的帮助，其中包括萨卡加维亚担任翻译。远征队带回日记、地图和标本，扩展了美国对当地地理的认识。这次远征也服务于美国扩张领土的目标；远征所经之地早已有居民，并非等待人们“发现”的荒地。

loc: 特里波利察（今希腊特里波利）

en.s: Greek insurgents captured Tripolitsa after a siege during the Greek War of Independence. The town was an important Ottoman administrative and military center in the Peloponnese, and its fall strengthened the insurgents' position in the region. Victory was followed by the mass killing of Muslim and Jewish residents, a central part of the event that cannot be separated from its military significance. Estimates of the number killed vary considerably between accounts. The capture provided the revolutionaries with weapons and resources, but it also illustrates the violence against civilians that accompanied the struggle to end Ottoman rule in Greece.
en.n: This entry marks the end of the siege, using the date convention of the cited article.

zh.t: 希腊起义军攻占特里波利察
zh.s: 希腊独立战争期间，希腊起义军围城后攻占了特里波利察。这座城镇是伯罗奔尼撒半岛上重要的奥斯曼行政和军事中心，失守后，起义军在当地的力量得到加强。胜利后发生了针对穆斯林和犹太居民的大规模屠杀；这是这场事件的重要组成部分，不能与军事意义割裂开来。不同记载对遇难人数的估计差别很大。起义军缴获了武器和物资，但这场攻城也反映了希腊摆脱奥斯曼统治的斗争中针对平民的暴力。
zh.n: 此条记录标记围城结束日，日期沿用引述文章采用的历法。

en.t: The Knickerbocker Base Ball Club is organized
en.s: The Knickerbocker Base Ball Club was organized by a group of New York players associated with Alexander Cartwright. Its members adopted a written set of playing rules prepared by William Wheaton and William Tucker. These rules helped shape the version of baseball that developed around New York, although the sport had many predecessors and cannot accurately be attributed to a single inventor. The club used the Elysian Fields in nearby Hoboken as its playing ground. Its organization and rule-making became important steps in baseball's transition from varied local games to a more standardized sport played by organized clubs.

zh.t: 尼克博克棒球俱乐部成立
zh.s: 一群与亚历山大·卡特赖特有关的纽约球员组建了尼克博克棒球俱乐部。成员采用了威廉·惠顿和威廉·塔克拟定的一套书面比赛规则。这些规则影响了后来在纽约地区发展的棒球，但棒球有许多早期形式，不能说是某个人单独发明的。俱乐部在附近新泽西州霍博肯的伊利西安球场比赛。俱乐部的成立和制定规则，推动了棒球从各地规则不一的游戏，逐渐发展为由俱乐部组织、规则较统一的运动。

en.t: A new planet is found through mathematics
en.s: Johann Gottfried Galle and Heinrich Louis d'Arrest identified Neptune at the Berlin Observatory after receiving a predicted position from French mathematician Urbain Le Verrier. Irregularities in the orbit of Uranus had suggested that another planet was exerting a gravitational pull. Rather than finding the object through a chance survey, the observers searched near the calculated position and compared what they saw with a star chart. John Couch Adams had independently worked on the same problem in Britain. The discovery became a celebrated demonstration of how mathematical predictions could guide observation and reveal previously unknown parts of the Solar System.

zh.t: 科学家通过数学计算发现海王星
zh.s: 柏林天文台的约翰·戈特弗里德·伽勒和海因里希·路易·达雷斯特，根据法国数学家于尔班·勒维耶尔预测的位置发现了海王星。天王星轨道的异常显示，可能有另一颗行星在施加引力。天文学家不是偶然巡天找到海王星，而是在计算位置附近搜寻，并将观察到的天体与星图比对。英国的约翰·柯西·亚当斯也曾独立研究同一问题。这次发现成为数学预测指导天文观测、揭示太阳系未知天体的著名案例。

en.s: Neptune is the eighth and farthest known planet orbiting the Sun. It is the fourth-largest planet in the Solar System by diameter, the third-most-massive planet, and the densest giant planet. It is 17 times the mass of Earth. Compared to Uranus, its neighbouring ice giant, Neptune is slightly smaller, but more massive and dense. Being composed primarily of gases and liquids, it has no well-defined solid surface.

zh.t: 海王星被发现
zh.s: 海王星是太阳系第八颗、已知距离太阳最远的行星。按直径计，它是太阳系第四大行星、质量第三大的行星，也是密度最高的巨行星。其质量为地球的17倍。与邻近的冰巨星天王星相比，海王星略小，但质量更大、密度更高。它主要由气体和液体构成，没有明确的固体表面。

en.s: King Wilhelm I appointed Otto von Bismarck minister president of Prussia during a constitutional confrontation over army reform and government spending. The king and the elected lower house had reached an impasse, and Bismarck offered a way to maintain the monarchy's program despite parliamentary resistance. His appointment began a long period of political leadership that transformed Prussia's position within Europe. In the years that followed, diplomacy and wars against Denmark, Austria, and France helped produce a German empire under Prussian leadership. The September appointment preceded those developments; it was not itself the date on which Germany became a unified state.

zh.t: 俾斯麦出任普鲁士首相
zh.s: 普鲁士国王威廉一世在军制改革和政府开支引发的宪政僵局中任命奥托·冯·俾斯麦为首相。国王与民选的下议院僵持不下，俾斯麦提出办法，使王室仍能推行原定政策。此次任命开启了俾斯麦长期执政的时期，也改变了普鲁士在欧洲的地位。此后，普鲁士通过外交以及与丹麦、奥地利和法国的战争，最终建立德意志帝国。9月的任命发生在这些发展之前；德国统一并非发生在这一天。

en.s: The Battle of Wood Lake occurred on September 23, 1862, and was the final battle in the Dakota War of 1862. The two-hour battle, which actually took place at nearby Lone Tree Lake, was a decisive victory for the U.S. forces led by Colonel Henry Hastings Sibley. With heavy casualties inflicted on the Dakota forces led by Chief Little Crow, the "hostile" Dakota warriors dispersed.

zh.t: 伍德湖战役
zh.s: 伍德湖战役发生于1862年9月23日，是1862年达科他战争的最后一场战斗。战斗持续约两小时，实际发生在附近的孤树湖。亨利·哈斯廷斯·西布利上校率领的美军取得决定性胜利，给小乌鸦酋长率领的达科他人造成重大伤亡后，被称为“敌对派”的达科他战士四散撤离。

en.s: The Battle of Sulphur Creek Trestle, also known as the Battle of Athens, was fought near Athens, Alabama (Limestone County, Alabama), from September 23 to 25, 1864 as part of the American Civil War. In September 1864, General Nathan Bedford Forrest led his force into northern Alabama and middle Tennessee to disrupt the supply of William Tecumseh Sherman's army in Georgia.
en.n: This entry records the event's start date, as given in the source infobox.

zh.t: 硫磺溪栈桥战役
zh.s: 美国内战期间，硫磺溪栈桥战役又称雅典战役，于1864年9月23日至25日在阿拉巴马州石灰岩县雅典附近爆发。1864年9月，内森·贝德福德·福雷斯特将军率军进入阿拉巴马州北部和田纳西州中部，试图切断威廉·特库姆塞·谢尔曼军队在佐治亚州的补给线。
zh.n: 此条记录采用原文资料框列明的事件开始日期。

en.t: Puerto Rico’s Grito de Lares uprising begins
en.s: Revolutionaries in the Puerto Rican town of Lares rose against Spanish colonial rule and proclaimed a republic. The movement was associated with organizers including Ramón Emeterio Betances and Segundo Ruiz Belvis, whose plans connected independence with broader political and social reform. The rebels briefly took control of Lares, but their attempt to expand the uprising was defeated and many participants were arrested. Although the revolt did not achieve independence, it became an enduring reference point in Puerto Rican political history. Its anniversary recalls both opposition to colonial government and the wider nineteenth-century struggle over freedom, citizenship, and slavery in the Caribbean.

zh.t: 波多黎各拉雷斯起义爆发
zh.s: 波多黎各拉雷斯镇的革命者起身反抗西班牙殖民统治，并宣布建立共和国。拉蒙·埃米特里奥·贝当斯和塞贡多·鲁伊斯·贝尔维斯等组织者参与了这场运动，他们的计划将独立与更广泛的政治和社会改革联系起来。起义者一度控制拉雷斯，但向外扩展起义的尝试被镇压，许多参与者被捕。起义未能实现独立，却成为波多黎各政治史上长久被提及的事件。每年的纪念日既回顾反抗殖民统治，也纪念19世纪加勒比地区围绕自由、公民权和奴隶制展开的斗争。

en.s: The Battle of Surubí (also spelt Suruby, Surubi-í, Surubi-hi, etc.) was fought in 23 September 1868, during the opening stages of the Paraguayan War's Pikysyry campaign. The allied army marched north, towards Paraguay's capital Asunción after the fall of the fortress of Humaitá a few weeks earlier. On the morning of 23 September, the Brazilian vanguard under General Andrade Neves, Baron of Triunfo, met two Paraguayan detachments at a bridge over the Surubí stream and beat them.

zh.t: 苏鲁比战役
zh.s: 1868年9月23日，巴拉圭战争皮基西里战役初期爆发苏鲁比战役，又写作Suruby、Surubi-í或Surubi-hi等。乌迈塔要塞数周前陷落后，盟军向北朝巴拉圭首都亚松森进军。23日上午，安德拉德·内维斯将军率领的巴西先头部队在苏鲁比溪上的桥边遇上两支巴拉圭分遣队，并将对方击败。

en.s: The siege of Toul was the siege of the fortified French town of Toul from 16 August to 23 September 1870 by Prussian, Bavarian and Württemberg forces during the Franco-Prussian War. Toul controlled a railway line leading to Germany and it was vital for the Germans to secure it to resupply and reinforce their armies in northern France.
en.n: This entry records the event's end date, as given in the source infobox.

zh.t: 土尔围城战
zh.s: 普法战争期间，普鲁士、巴伐利亚和符腾堡军队于1870年8月16日至9月23日围攻法国设防城市土尔。该城控制着一条通往德国的铁路，对德军向法国北部补给和增援至关重要。
zh.n: 此条记录采用原文资料框列明的事件结束日期。

en.s: The Yellowstone Expedition of 1873 was an expedition of the United States Army in the summer of 1873 in Dakota Territory and Montana Territory, to survey a route for the Northern Pacific Railroad along the Yellowstone River. The expedition was under the overall command of Colonel David S. Stanley, with Lieutenant Colonel George A. Custer second in command.
en.n: This entry records the event's end date, as given in the source infobox.

zh.t: 1873年黄石远征
zh.s: 1873年夏，美国陆军在达科他领地和蒙大拿领地组织黄石远征，沿黄石河勘察北太平洋铁路的路线。远征由大卫·S·斯坦利上校全面指挥，乔治·A·卡斯特中校担任副指挥。
zh.n: 此条记录采用原文资料框列明的事件结束日期。

en.t: An Aromanian cultural society is founded in Romania
en.s: The Macedo-Romanian Cultural Society was established in Romania as the successor to an earlier committee founded in 1860. It aimed to support the language and culture of Aromanian communities, whose populations were spread across the Balkans. The organization became involved in education and cultural activity and received recognition as a legal entity the following year. Its work also reflected a particular understanding of Aromanian identity: the society regarded Aromanians as part of the Romanian people while emphasizing their distinctive characteristics. That institutional position should be distinguished from the diverse identities and views held by Aromanian individuals and communities.

zh.t: 马其顿—罗马尼亚文化协会成立
zh.s: 马其顿—罗马尼亚文化协会在罗马尼亚成立，接替1860年成立的一个早期委员会。协会旨在支持散居巴尔干各地的阿罗马尼亚社群的语言和文化，后来参与教育与文化活动，并于次年获得法人资格。协会对阿罗马尼亚人身份有自己的理解：它认为阿罗马尼亚人属于罗马尼亚民族，同时也有独特的特点。应将这一机构立场与阿罗马尼亚社群成员各自不同的身份认同和看法区分开来。

en.s: Parliamentary elections were held in Greece on 23 September 1879. Supporters of Alexandros Koumoundouros and Theodoros Deligiannis emerged as the largest bloc in Parliament, with 100 of the 207 seats. Koumoundouros remained Prime Minister until 22 March the following year.

zh.t: 希腊议会选举（1879年）
zh.s: 希腊于1879年9月23日举行议会选举。亚历山德罗斯·库蒙杜罗斯和西奥多罗斯·德利扬尼斯的支持者合计赢得207个席位中的100席，成为议会中最大的政治阵营。库蒙杜罗斯继续担任总理，直到次年3月22日。

en.t: A shipwreck precedes the Tierra del Fuego gold rush
en.s: The French steamship Arctique ran aground near Cape Virgenes on the northern side of the Strait of Magellan. A rescue expedition subsequently found gold at nearby Zanja a Pique, and news of the discovery drew prospectors from Punta Arenas and farther afield. The rush later spread across parts of Tierra del Fuego, involving both Argentine and Chilean territories. Mining brought new settlements, commercial activity, and profound disruption to Indigenous communities. The anniversary marks the grounding that set this sequence in motion, rather than suggesting that the entire regional gold rush or its consequences happened on a single day.
en.n: The grounding occurred during the night of September 23–24; the later gold discovery followed the rescue expedition.

zh.t: “北极”号触礁，火地岛淘金热随后兴起
zh.s: 法国蒸汽船“北极”号在麦哲伦海峡北侧、维尔赫内斯角附近触礁。随后前来救援的队伍在附近的皮克溪发现黄金，消息传开后，蓬塔阿雷纳斯及更远地区的淘金者纷纷赶来。此后淘金热扩展到火地岛部分地区，涉及阿根廷和智利领土。采矿带来新的聚居点和商业活动，也严重冲击当地原住民社群。纪念日对应的是触礁事件，它引发了后续发展，并不意味着整个地区的淘金热及其影响都发生在同一天。
zh.n: 触礁发生在9月23日至24日夜间；救援队后来才发现黄金。

en.t: Ethiopian forces defeat the Mahdists at Kufit
en.s: Ethiopian forces led by Ras Alula defeated a Mahdist army associated with Osman Digna at Kufit. The engagement took place in the borderlands between the Ethiopian and Sudanese spheres of power, in what is now Eritrea. It formed part of the wider fighting linked to the rise of the Mahdist state in Sudan. Accounts differ on the sizes of the opposing armies, so precise strength and casualty estimates should be treated cautiously. The victory is a significant episode in Ras Alula's military career and in the history of conflict across the northeastern African highlands and lowlands.
en.n: The source dates the battle to September 22–23, 1885; this entry marks its concluding day.

zh.t: 埃塞俄比亚军队在库菲特击败马赫迪军
zh.s: 阿卢拉·恩格达上将率领埃塞俄比亚军队，在库菲特击败了奥斯曼·迪格纳指挥的马赫迪军。这场战斗发生在埃塞俄比亚和苏丹势力范围交界地带，即今厄立特里亚境内，也是苏丹马赫迪国家崛起相关冲突的一部分。不同记载对双方兵力规模说法不一，具体人数和伤亡估算应谨慎看待。这场胜利是阿卢拉军事生涯中的重要一役，也反映了非洲东北部高地和低地间的冲突史。
zh.n: 来源记载的战斗时间为1885年9月22日至23日；本条记录战斗结束日。

en.t: Nintendo begins with a deck of cards
en.s: Fusajiro Yamauchi established the business that became Nintendo in Kyoto, Japan. Its original products were hanafuda, traditional playing cards decorated with flowers and other seasonal imagery. This was a small manufacturing enterprise, far removed from the electronic games with which the company would later be associated. Over subsequent decades, Nintendo expanded its card business and experimented with other products before moving into toys and electronic entertainment. Its founding illustrates how a familiar modern technology company can have roots in an older craft industry. The September anniversary refers to the original playing-card business, not the launch of a video-game console.

zh.t: 任天堂从花札生意起步
zh.s: 山内房治郎在日本京都创办了后来成为任天堂的企业。公司最初生产花札，这种传统纸牌绘有花卉和其他季节图案。那时还是小型制造业，和任天堂后来以电子游戏闻名的形象相距甚远。此后数十年，公司拓展纸牌业务，并尝试其他产品，后来才进入玩具和电子娱乐领域。任天堂的发展说明，如今广为人知的科技公司也可能起源于传统手工业。9月的纪念日对应纸牌业务创立，并非电子游戏主机发布。

loc: 菲律宾奥隆阿波和苏比克湾

en.t: American forces destroy a coastal gun at Olongapo
en.s: American naval forces completed an operation against a Filipino coastal artillery position near Olongapo during the Philippine-American War. Earlier exchanges had demonstrated the danger posed by the gun to ships in Subic Bay. On the final day of the operation, a landing party went ashore under naval cover and destroyed the position. The fighting was part of the United States campaign against the First Philippine Republic after the end of Spanish colonial rule. Although relatively small, the engagement illustrates the importance of coastal defenses, naval firepower, and control of harbors in the wider struggle over Philippine independence.
en.n: The operation ran from September 18 to 23; this entry records its final action.

zh.t: 美军在奥隆阿波摧毁岸防炮
zh.s: 美军海军在美菲战争期间完成了一次针对奥隆阿波附近菲律宾岸防炮阵地的行动。此前的交火已显示，这门炮会威胁苏比克湾内的船只。行动最后一天，登陆部队在海军掩护下上岸，摧毁了炮位。这场战斗属于西班牙殖民统治结束后美国对抗菲律宾第一共和国的军事行动。虽然规模不大，但它反映了岸防、海军火力和港口控制在菲律宾独立斗争中的重要性。
zh.n: 行动从9月18日持续至23日；本条记录的是最后一天的战斗。

loc: 瑞典卡尔斯塔德（谈判地点）

en.t: Norway and Sweden reach an agreement at Karlstad
en.s: Negotiators from Norway and Sweden concluded their discussions at Karlstad over the peaceful dissolution of their union. Norway's parliament had declared the union ended in June, and a Norwegian referendum had strongly supported that decision, but important issues still required negotiation. The settlement addressed matters including border defenses and helped avert armed conflict. Parliamentary approvals followed in October, and the Swedish king formally relinquished his claim to the Norwegian throne later that month. September 23 therefore marks the conclusion of the negotiations, not every legal step in separation. The process became a notable example of a negotiated end to a political union.
en.n: The agreement preceded parliamentary approvals and Sweden's formal recognition on October 26.

zh.t: 挪威和瑞典在卡尔斯塔德达成协议
zh.s: 挪威和瑞典谈判代表在卡尔斯塔德结束了关于和平解散两国联盟的谈判。挪威议会已于6月宣布联盟结束，挪威公投也以压倒性结果支持这一决定，但仍有重要问题需要协商。协议处理了边境防御等事项，避免了武装冲突。两国议会在10月批准协议，瑞典国王也于当月晚些时候正式放弃对挪威王位的主张。因此，9月23日是谈判结束的日期，并非联盟解散的所有法律步骤都在这一天完成。这一过程后来成为通过谈判结束政治联盟的著名案例。
zh.n: 协议签署早于两国议会批准，也早于瑞典在10月26日正式承认挪威独立。

en.s: The 1909 Rangitikei by-election was a by-election held during the 17th New Zealand Parliament in the Rangitikei electorate of the North Island. This was the sixth by-election since the Rangitikei electorate was established for the 1861 election. The previous by-election took place in 1892 and the following one took place in 1978.

zh.t: 1909年兰吉蒂凯补选
zh.s: 1909年兰吉蒂凯补选是在新西兰第17届议会期间举行的一次补选，选区位于北岛的兰吉蒂凯。自1861年该选区设立以来，这是第6次补选；上一次于1892年举行，下一次则在1978年举行。

en.t: Colorado coal miners begin a major strike
en.s: Coal miners in southern Colorado began a strike supported by the United Mine Workers of America. The dispute concerned wages, working conditions, and union recognition in an industry where companies exercised extensive control over workers' employment and housing. Striking families were evicted from company homes and moved into tent colonies supported by the union, sometimes before adequate shelter was ready. Confrontations with mine guards and state forces escalated over the following months into the Colorado Coalfield War. The Ludlow Massacre occurred the next year. This anniversary records the beginning of the strike rather than placing that later violence on the same date.

zh.t: 科罗拉多州煤矿工人举行大罢工
zh.s: 科罗拉多州南部煤矿工人在美国联合矿工工会支持下开始罢工，要求改善工资和工作条件，并承认工会。当时矿业公司对工人的雇用和住房有很大控制权。矿工家庭被逐出公司住房，搬进工会支持的帐篷营地，有时连基本庇护都还没准备好。此后几个月，矿工与矿场守卫及州政府力量的冲突不断升级，最终演变为科罗拉多煤田战争。卢德洛大屠杀发生在次年。这个纪念日对应罢工开始，并不意味着之后发生的暴力也在同一天。

loc: 弗雷瑞斯—圣拉斐尔（出发地）

en.t: Roland Garros flies nonstop across the Mediterranean
en.s: French aviator Roland Garros completed the first nonstop airplane crossing of the Mediterranean Sea, flying from the Fréjus–Saint-Raphaël area of southern France to Bizerte in Tunisia. He used a Morane-Saulnier monoplane for a journey lasting nearly eight hours. Engine difficulties during the crossing underscored the risks of early long-distance flight over water, where an emergency landing offered few safe options. The achievement added to Garros's reputation following earlier altitude records and air races. It belongs to the experimental era before regular passenger aviation, when individual flights tested the practical limits of aircraft engines, navigation, endurance, and fuel supply.

zh.t: 罗兰·加洛斯不间断飞越地中海
zh.s: 法国飞行员罗兰·加洛斯首次驾驶飞机不间断飞越地中海，从法国南部弗雷瑞斯—圣拉斐尔地区飞到突尼斯比塞大。他驾驶莫拉纳-索尔尼埃单翼飞机，飞行近8小时。飞行途中发动机出现问题，凸显了早期远距离海上飞行的风险：一旦发生紧急情况，几乎没有安全的迫降地点。此前，加洛斯已凭借高空飞行纪录和航空竞赛建立声誉。这次飞行属于定期客运尚未出现的航空试验时期，当时飞行员不断挑战发动机、导航、续航和燃料供应的极限。

en.s: The Ohrid–Debar uprising (Macedonian: Охридско-Дебaрско вoстание, romanized: Ohridsko-Debarsko vostanie; Bulgarian: Охридско-Дебърско въстание, romanized: Ohridsko-Debarsko vastanie; Albanian: Kryengritja e Ohrit dhe Dibrës) was an uprising by the population in Western Macedonia, then Kingdom of Serbia, in September 1913. It was organized by the Internal Macedonian Revolutionary Organization (IMRO) and Albania against the Serbian capture of the regions of Ohrid, Debar and Struga after the Balkan Wars (1912–13).
en.n: This entry records the event's start date, as given in the source infobox.

zh.t: 奥赫里德—迪伯尔起义
zh.s: 奥赫里德—迪伯尔起义发生于1913年9月，地点是当时属塞尔维亚王国的马其顿西部地区。马其顿内部革命组织和阿尔巴尼亚方面组织了这场起义，反抗塞尔维亚在巴尔干战争（1912—1913年）后占领奥赫里德、迪伯尔和斯特鲁加等地。
zh.n: 此条记录采用原文资料框列明的事件开始日期。

en.t: The United Mine Workers of America launch a strike which eventually escalated into the Colorado Coalfield War
en.s: The United Mine Workers of America (UMW or UMWA) is a North American labor union best known for representing coal miners. Today, the Union also represents health care workers, truck drivers, manufacturing workers and public employees in the United States and Canada. Although its main focus has always been on workers and their rights, the UMW of today also advocates for better roads, schools, and universal health care.

zh.t: 美国矿工联合会发动罢工，最终引发科罗拉多煤田战争
zh.s: 美国矿工联合会（UMW或UMWA）是北美工会，以代表煤矿工人而闻名。如今，该工会还代表美国和加拿大的医护人员、卡车司机、制造业工人和公共部门雇员。除了一贯关注工人及其权益外，工会现今也倡导改善道路和学校，并推动全民医疗保障。

en.s: The Battle of Mount Csindrel was a World War I military engagement between German and Romanian forces. It was part of the 1916 Battle of Transylvania and resulted in a tactical victory for the Romanians.

zh.t: 钦德雷尔山战役
zh.s: 钦德雷尔山战役是第一次世界大战期间德国和罗马尼亚军队之间的一场战斗，属于1916年特兰西瓦尼亚战役的一部分，战术上由罗马尼亚获胜。

en.s: The Battle of Taif was fought between Ottoman forces and Syed Hussien bin Ali Sharif of Mecca in 1916. The Ottoman Army was in Taif, with Syed's forces besieging the city and after many weeks siege and fiercest struggle Syed's forces were able to capture the Taif. After the fall of Mecca in July 1916 the fall of Taif was a major blow for Turks who were fighting in First World War against Britain.
en.n: This entry records the event's end date, as given in the source infobox.

zh.t: 塔伊夫战役（1916年）
zh.s: 1916年，奥斯曼军队与麦加谢里夫赛义德·侯赛因·本·阿里交战。奥斯曼军驻守塔伊夫，赛义德的部队围攻该城。经过数周围困和激烈战斗，赛义德的部队最终攻占塔伊夫。麦加于1916年7月陷落后，塔伊夫失守又给第一次世界大战中与英国作战的土耳其军队以重大打击。
zh.n: 此条记录采用原文资料框列明的事件结束日期。

en.s: Indian cavalry serving in the British Empire's forces captured Haifa during the closing months of the First World War. Units including the Jodhpur and Mysore Lancers attacked defended positions near the town as Ottoman forces retreated after the Battle of Megiddo. The fighting involved difficult ground between the Kishon River and Mount Carmel, with artillery and machine guns protecting the approaches. Securing Haifa gave the advancing army access to a useful port closer to its front. The engagement is remembered particularly in India, where the contribution of the cavalry regiments is commemorated through the annual observance of Haifa Day.

zh.t: 印度骑兵攻占海法
zh.s: 第一次世界大战末期，在大英帝国军队服役的印度骑兵攻占海法。焦特布尔枪骑兵和迈索尔枪骑兵等部队在米吉多战役后奥斯曼军队撤退时，进攻镇附近的防守阵地。基顺河与迦密山之间地形复杂，炮兵和机枪封锁了接近海法的道路。攻占该地后，推进中的英军获得了一个靠近前线的实用港口。海法战役在印度尤其受到纪念，当地每年举行“海法日”，纪念骑兵团的贡献。

loc: 美国堪萨斯州东部（风暴消散地点）

en.t: The 1920 Louisiana hurricane dissipates over Kansas
en.s: The hurricane that had struck Louisiana earlier in the week dissipated over eastern Kansas on September 23. It had developed in the western Caribbean, crossed Central America and the Yucatán Peninsula, then intensified over the Gulf of Mexico before reaching the Louisiana coast as a Category 2 hurricane. The storm forced thousands of people to leave Galveston Island, brought damaging winds and heavy rain to the Gulf Coast, and disrupted rail lines. Its recorded toll was two deaths and about $1.45 million in damage in 1920 dollars. This anniversary marks the end of the storm, rather than its earlier landfall near Houma.

zh.t: 1920年路易斯安那飓风在堪萨斯州消散
zh.s: 本周早些时候袭击路易斯安那州的飓风于9月23日在堪萨斯州东部消散。风暴先在加勒比海西部形成，穿过中美洲和尤卡坦半岛，在墨西哥湾增强后，以二级飓风强度登陆路易斯安那州。它迫使数千人离开加尔维斯顿岛，在墨西哥湾沿岸造成强风和暴雨，并中断铁路运输。记录显示，风暴造成2人死亡，损失约145万美元（按1920年币值计算）。本条纪念风暴消散，而不是它此前在霍玛附近登陆。

en.s: The Battle of Sejny (Polish: Bitwa o Sejny), Battle of Suwałki (Lithuanian: Suvalkų mūšis) or Sejny-Augustów operation (Lithuanian: Seinų-Augustavo operacija) took place during 2–23 September 1920, between the Polish and Lithuanian armies in the Suwałki Region. The fighting was especially focused on the towns of Sejny, Suwałki and Augustów (now in Poland).
en.n: This entry records the event's end date, as given in the source infobox.

zh.t: 塞伊内战役
zh.s: 塞伊内战役又称苏瓦乌基战役或塞伊内—奥古斯图夫行动，于1920年9月2日至23日在苏瓦乌基地区进行，交战双方为波兰和立陶宛军队。战斗主要发生在塞伊内、苏瓦乌基和奥古斯图夫等城镇（现均属波兰）。
zh.n: 此条记录采用原文资料框列明的事件结束日期。

en.t: The Kingdom of Saudi Arabia is proclaimed
en.s: The territories ruled by Abdulaziz Ibn Saud were brought together under the name Kingdom of Saudi Arabia. The proclamation followed decades of military campaigns and political consolidation on the Arabian Peninsula, including the establishment of his authority over Nejd and the Hejaz. The new kingdom joined regions with different local histories under a single monarchy. September 23 subsequently became the date of Saudi National Day, commemorating the unification and the adoption of the country's modern name. The anniversary concerns this political formation in 1932, rather than the beginning of settlement, culture, or earlier Saudi states in the peninsula.

zh.t: 沙特阿拉伯王国宣告成立
zh.s: 阿卜杜勒-阿齐兹·伊本·沙特统治的领土合并为沙特阿拉伯王国。此前，他历经数十年的军事行动和政治整合，逐步确立对内志和汉志等地的统治。新王国将历史各异的地区纳入同一君主制之下。此后，9月23日成为沙特国庆日，纪念国家统一和采用现今国名。1932年的这次政治建国并不意味着阿拉伯半岛上的定居、文化或早期沙特国家也是从这一天才开始。

en.t: Saudi Arabia: Proclamation of the Kingdom of Saudi Arabia
en.s: Saudi Arabia, officially the Kingdom of Saudi Arabia (KSA), is a country in West Asia that occupies the bulk of the Arabian Peninsula. Covering a land area of approximately 2,149,690 km2 (830,000 sq mi), it is the fifth-largest country in Asia and the twelfth-largest in the world.

zh.t: 沙特阿拉伯宣布成立王国
zh.s: 沙特阿拉伯正式国名为沙特阿拉伯王国，是西亚国家，占据阿拉伯半岛大部。国土面积约2,149,690平方公里（830,000平方英里），是亚洲面积第五大、世界面积第12大的国家。

en.s: The 1934 All-Ireland Senior Football Championship final was the 47th All-Ireland Final and the deciding match of the 1934 All-Ireland Senior Football Championship, an inter-county Gaelic football tournament for the top teams in Ireland.

zh.s: 1934年全爱尔兰高级足球锦标赛决赛是第47届全爱尔兰决赛，也是当年跨郡盖尔式足球锦标赛的冠军争夺战。

en.s: The EMLL 4th Anniversary Show was a professional wrestling major show event produced by Empresa Mexicana de Lucha Libre (EMLL, later renamed Consejo Mundial de Lucha Libre, CMLL) that took place on September 23, 1937 in Arena Modelo (In the same location Arena México was built years later), in Mexico City, Mexico. The event commemorated the fourth anniversary of EMLL, which would become the oldest still active professional wrestling promotion in the world. The Anniversary show is EMLL's biggest show of the year, their Super Bowl event.

zh.t: 墨西哥摔角公司第四届周年纪念赛
zh.s: 墨西哥自由摔跤公司（EMLL，后更名为世界摔角理事会CMLL）于1937年9月23日在墨西哥城的莫德洛竞技场举办第四届周年纪念赛。该场比赛纪念EMLL成立4周年；EMLL后来成为仍在运营的最古老职业摔角推广公司。周年纪念赛是该公司一年中规模最大的赛事，相当于他们的“超级碗”。数年后，墨西哥竞技场建在莫德洛竞技场原址。

en.t: Westinghouse buries a message for the distant future
en.s: Westinghouse buried a time capsule at the site of the coming New York World's Fair in Flushing Meadows. Designed to remain unopened until the year 6939, it contained objects and records intended to describe twentieth-century life to people thousands of years in the future. Its contents combined everyday materials with written and visual information, while a widely distributed Book of Record explained its purpose and location. The project helped popularize the expression 'time capsule.' It was both a corporate exhibition and an ambitious exercise in historical preservation, reflecting contemporary hopes and anxieties about what future civilizations might understand of the present.

zh.t: 西屋公司埋下写给遥远未来的信息
zh.s: 西屋公司在纽约世界博览会预定会址——法拉盛草原公园埋下一只时间胶囊，计划到6939年才开启。胶囊里装有物品和记录，希望能向数千年后的读者介绍20世纪生活。内容既有日常用品，也有文字和图像资料；广泛发行的《记录之书》说明了胶囊的目的和位置。这个项目推动了“时间胶囊”一词的普及。它既是企业展览，也是一项雄心勃勃的历史保存尝试，反映了当时人们对未来文明能否理解现代生活的期待与担忧。

en.s: The World War II Battle of Krasnobród took place on 23 September 1939 near the town of Krasnobród. It was fought between the forces of the Polish Army and the German Wehrmacht during the Invasion of Poland. It was one of the last battles in European warfare in which cavalry was used on both sides.

zh.t: 克拉斯诺布鲁德战役（1939年）
zh.s: 第二次世界大战期间的克拉斯诺布鲁德战役于1939年9月23日在该镇附近爆发。波兰军队与入侵波兰的德国国防军交战。这是欧洲战争中最后几场双方都使用骑兵的战役之一。

en.s: The Battle of Kodziowce was a battle that took place at Kodziowce (now in modern Belarus) that occurred on 23-24 September 1939 during the Soviet invasion of Poland. It was fought between the Polish Wołkowysk Cavalry Brigade commanded by Wacław Przeździecki and Edmund Heldut-Tarnasiewicz who were retreating from the Battle of Grodno (1939) and the Soviet 2nd Light Armoured Brigade under Col. Alexey Kurkin.

zh.t: 科济沃夫采战役
zh.s: 1939年9月23日至24日，苏联入侵波兰期间，科济沃夫采村附近爆发战斗。波兰沃乌科维斯克骑兵旅由瓦茨瓦夫·普热兹杰茨基和埃德蒙·海尔杜特-塔尔纳谢维奇指挥，此前正从格罗德诺战役撤退；苏军则由阿列克谢·库尔金上校率领第二轻型装甲旅。

en.t: Fighting along the Matanikau opens on Guadalcanal
en.s: United States Marines began an operation west of their defensive perimeter on Guadalcanal, opening the September fighting near the Matanikau River. Japanese troops were established in the area as both sides sought to improve their positions during the wider Guadalcanal campaign. The fighting developed over several days and involved difficult terrain, incomplete information, and problems coordinating separated Marine units. The September operation failed to remove the Japanese forces from the area, and further battles followed in October. These actions formed part of the struggle for control of Guadalcanal and its strategically important airfield during the Pacific war.
en.n: This entry marks the beginning of the September 23–27 action, not its outcome on the first day.

zh.t: 瓜达尔卡纳尔岛马塔尼考河战斗打响
zh.s: 美国海军陆战队从瓜达尔卡纳尔岛防线向西展开行动，开启9月马塔尼考河附近的战斗。日军已在该地区部署，双方都试图在瓜达尔卡纳尔岛战役期间改善阵地。战斗持续数日，地形困难、情报不全，分散的陆战队部队之间也难以协调。9月的行动未能将日军赶出该地区，10月又发生后续战斗。这些战斗属于太平洋战争期间争夺瓜达尔卡纳尔岛及其重要机场的行动。
zh.n: 本条记录9月23日至27日系列战斗的开始，不是首日的战果。

en.s: The Italian Social Republic was proclaimed with Benito Mussolini at its head after his rescue from captivity by German forces. It emerged following his removal from power in July and Italy's armistice with the Allies in September. Dependent on Nazi Germany, the new fascist regime claimed authority over Italy but operated principally in German-occupied northern and central areas. Government offices were dispersed, with Salò becoming closely associated with the regime. Its establishment deepened Italy's division between competing authorities and helped frame the ensuing civil war. The republic lasted until the collapse of Axis control in Italy in the spring of 1945.

zh.t: 墨索里尼宣布成立意大利社会共和国
zh.s: 意大利社会共和国宣布成立，由贝尼托·墨索里尼领导。此前，墨索里尼于7月下台，意大利又在9月与盟军停战，随后德国军队将他从囚禁中救出。这个新的法西斯政权依附纳粹德国，声称统治整个意大利，实际控制范围主要在德国占领的中部和北部。政府机关分散在各地，萨洛镇逐渐成为政权的代称。该政权成立后，意大利在相互对立的当局之间进一步分裂，内战随之延续。1945年春，轴心国在意大利的控制瓦解，共和国也告终。

loc: 纳粹德国占领下的维尔纽斯

en.t: The final liquidation of the Vilna Ghetto begins
en.s: Nazi authorities began the final liquidation of the Vilna Ghetto, dismantling a Jewish community already devastated by mass murder, forced labor, and deportation. Residents were selected for deportation to camps or killed, while a limited number of workers remained temporarily in separate labor facilities. The destruction extended across more than one day and followed earlier waves of persecution since the German occupation of the city. Despite the conditions, ghetto residents had sustained educational, cultural, and resistance activities. The September liquidation marks a central episode in the Holocaust in Lithuania and the destruction of one of Eastern Europe's major Jewish cultural centers.
en.n: The principal liquidation is dated September 23–24; deportations and killings were part of a longer process.

zh.t: 维尔纽斯犹太区最终清剿开始
zh.s: 纳粹当局开始最终清剿维尔纽斯犹太区。此前，这里的犹太社区已因大屠杀、强迫劳动和驱逐而遭到重创。居民被挑选送往集中营或遭杀害，少数工人则暂时被留在另设的劳工设施中。清剿持续了不止一天；自德国占领该城以来，迫害已一波接一波地发生。即使身处极端处境，犹太区居民仍维持教育、文化活动并组织抵抗。9月的清剿是立陶宛大屠杀中的重要事件，也标志着东欧主要犹太文化中心之一遭到毁灭。
zh.n: 主要清剿发生在9月23日至24日；驱逐和杀戮是持续更久过程的一部分。

en.s: Operation Achse (German: Fall Achse, lit. 'Case Axis'), originally called Operation Alaric (Unternehmen Alarich), was the German operation to forcibly disarm the Italian armed forces after Italy's armistice with the Allies on 3 September 1943. Several German divisions had entered Italy after the fall of Benito Mussolini in July 1943, while Italy was officially still an ally of Germany, despite the protests of the new Italian government under Pietro Badoglio.

zh.t: “轴心”行动
zh.s: “轴心”行动原名“阿拉里克行动”，是德国在意大利与盟军于1943年9月3日停战后，强行解除意大利军队武装的军事行动。1943年7月贝尼托·墨索里尼下台后，数个德国师已进入意大利；当时意大利仍是德国盟友，但皮埃特罗·巴多格里奥新政府对此表示抗议。

en.s: ONS 18 and ON 202 were North Atlantic convoys of the ONS/ON series which ran during the battle of the Atlantic in World War II. They were the subject of a major U-boat attack in September 1943, the first battle in the Kriegsmarine's autumn offensive, following the withdrawal from the North Atlantic route after Black May.

zh.t: ONS 18/ON 202号护航船队战役
zh.s: ONS 18号和ON 202号是二战大西洋战役期间的北大西洋护航船队。1943年9月，德国海军潜艇对这两支船队发动大规模袭击，这是德国海军结束“黑色五月”后撤出北大西洋航线、转入秋季攻势以来的第一场战役。

en.s: The 1945 All-Ireland Senior Football Championship final was a Gaelic football match played at Croke Park on 23 September 1945 to determine the winners of the 1945 All-Ireland Senior Football Championship, the 59th season of the All-Ireland Senior Football Championship, a tournament organised by the Gaelic Athletic Association for the champions of the four provinces of Ireland.

zh.t: 1945年全爱尔兰高级足球锦标赛决赛
zh.s: 1945年全爱尔兰高级足球锦标赛决赛于1945年9月23日在克罗克公园举行，决出当年的冠军。这是全爱尔兰高级足球锦标赛第59个赛季，由盖尔运动协会组织，参赛者为爱尔兰四个省级锦标赛的冠军队。

en.s: The 1945–1946 War in Southern Vietnam, codenamed Operation Masterdom by the British, and also known as the Southern Resistance War (Vietnamese: Nam Bộ kháng chiến) by the Vietnamese, was an armed conflict in Vietnam south of the 16th parallel during which British-Indian and French forces fought to suppress Vietnamese independence movements, which included non-communist nationalists, Trotskyists, and the Stalinist-front Viet Minh, to take control of the southern half of the country.

zh.s: 这场发生于越南北纬16度以南地区的武装冲突，时间为1945年至1946年。英国称之为“主宰行动”，越南方面也称“南部抗战”。英属印度部队和法国军队在此期间打击争取越南独立的各类运动，其中包括非共产党民族主义者、托洛茨基主义者，以及以斯大林主义为核心的越盟武装，试图控制越南南部。

en.t: A destructive earthquake strikes northeastern Iran
en.s: A powerful earthquake struck the area around Dustabad in northeastern Iran, devastating small and often remote settlements. Modern estimates place the mainshock at about magnitude 6.9. A substantial aftershock followed three days later and contributed to the destruction, making it difficult to separate every reported loss between the two events. Hundreds of people died, with estimates commonly around 500 for the sequence. Damage affected villages near Dustabad, Charmeh, Sarayan, and Ferdows. Later investigations examined possible fault ruptures, but the limited contemporary observations left uncertainties about the precise source. The disaster illustrates the difficulties of reconstructing older earthquakes in sparsely documented regions.
en.n: September 23 marks the mainshock; casualty estimates may include the September 26 aftershock.

zh.t: 伊朗东北部发生强震
zh.s: 伊朗东北部杜斯塔巴德一带发生强震，许多规模较小、位置偏远的村落遭到严重破坏。现代估算认为主震震级约为6.9级。三天后发生的强余震也加重了破坏，因此很难把所有伤亡分别归到两次地震。整个地震序列造成数百人死亡，常见估计约为500人。杜斯塔巴德、查尔梅、萨拉扬和费尔多斯附近的村庄均受灾。后来的调查研究了可能的断层破裂，但当时记录有限，震源位置仍有不确定性。这场灾难也说明，缺少详细记录会让人难以还原早期地震。
zh.n: 9月23日是主震日期；伤亡估计可能也包括9月26日的余震。

en.t: Truman announces evidence of a Soviet atomic explosion
en.s: President Harry Truman publicly announced that the United States had evidence of a recent atomic explosion in the Soviet Union. American monitoring had detected radioactive material following the Soviet Union's first nuclear test, conducted in August at Semipalatinsk in what is now Kazakhstan. The announcement ended public uncertainty about whether the American nuclear monopoly still held and marked an important stage in the Cold War arms race. Truman also renewed the case for international control of atomic energy. This anniversary concerns the public disclosure, not the test itself, which had taken place several weeks before the September statement.
en.n: The RDS-1 test took place on August 29; September 23 is the American announcement.

zh.t: 杜鲁门宣布掌握苏联核爆证据
zh.s: 美国总统哈里·杜鲁门公开宣布，美国掌握了苏联近期进行核爆炸的证据。美国监测人员在苏联8月于今哈萨克斯坦塞米巴拉金斯克进行首次核试验后，检测到了放射性物质。这一宣布结束了外界对美国是否仍垄断核武器的猜测，也标志着冷战军备竞赛进入重要阶段。杜鲁门还再次主张对原子能实行国际管控。本条纪念的是美国公开消息，而不是苏联核试验本身；试验在几周前已经进行。
zh.n: RDS-1核试验于8月29日进行；9月23日是美国宣布掌握证据的日期。

en.t: Congress overrides Truman's veto of the Internal Security Act
en.s: The United States Congress enacted the Internal Security Act over President Harry Truman's veto. Often called the McCarran Act, it required organizations classified as communist to register with federal authorities and established a board to investigate alleged subversive activity. Other provisions concerned detention during emergencies and restrictions on entry and citizenship. Truman had objected that the measure threatened civil liberties while offering ineffective protection against genuine security threats. Its passage came during the Korean War and an intense period of domestic anticommunism. Subsequent court decisions and legislation limited or removed important provisions, reflecting the continuing conflict between national security claims and constitutional protections.

zh.t: 美国国会推翻杜鲁门对《国内安全法》的否决
zh.s: 美国国会推翻总统哈里·杜鲁门的否决，正式通过《国内安全法》，该法也称《麦卡伦法》。法律要求被认定为共产主义组织的团体向联邦政府登记，并设立委员会调查所谓颠覆活动。其他条款涉及紧急状态下的拘留，以及入境和公民身份限制。杜鲁门反对该法，认为它会损害公民自由，却无法有效应对真正的安全威胁。法案在朝鲜战争期间、美国国内反共气氛强烈时通过。之后，法院判决和新法律限制或废除了其中重要条款，反映出国家安全主张与宪法权利之间的长期冲突。

en.t: British troops face a disastrous air strike on Hill 282
en.s: British troops of the Argyll and Sutherland Highlanders captured Hill 282 during operations near the Naktong River in the Korean War. North Korean forces then counterattacked from nearby higher ground, placing the British position under intense pressure. An American air strike intended to assist the ground fighting instead hit the British-held hill after failures in identification and communication. Napalm and gunfire caused severe casualties and forced survivors to withdraw. Major Kenneth Muir helped organize resistance and evacuation and was later awarded the Victoria Cross posthumously. The battle became a particularly costly example of the dangers of poorly coordinated air support.

zh.t: 英军在282高地遭遇灾难性空袭
zh.s: 朝鲜战争期间，阿盖尔和萨瑟兰高地兵团的英军在洛东江附近作战，攻占282高地。随后，朝鲜军队从附近更高处发起反攻，英军阵地承受巨大压力。原本要支援地面战斗的美军空袭因识别和通信失误，反而击中了英军占据的高地。燃烧弹和机枪火力造成惨重伤亡，幸存者被迫撤退。肯尼斯·缪尔少校组织抵抗和撤离，后来被追授维多利亚十字勋章。这场战斗成为空地协同失误所造成严重后果的典型案例。

en.s: The 1951 All-Ireland Senior Football Championship final was the 64th All-Ireland Final and the deciding match of the 1951 All-Ireland Senior Football Championship, an inter-county Gaelic football tournament for the top teams in Ireland. Mayo and Meath met to decide the destination of the Sam Maguire Cup.

zh.t: 1951年全爱尔兰高级足球锦标赛决赛
zh.s: 1951年全爱尔兰高级足球锦标赛决赛是第64届全爱尔兰决赛，也是当年跨郡盖尔式足球锦标赛的冠军争夺战。梅奥队与米斯队争夺萨姆·马奎尔杯。

en.t: George VI, king of the United Kingdom, has his left lung removed in an operation after a malignant tumour was found
en.s: George VI (Albert Frederick Arthur George; 14 December 1895 – 6 February 1952) was King of the United Kingdom and the Dominions of the British Commonwealth from 11 December 1936 until his death in 1952. He was also the last Emperor of India from 1936 until the British Raj was dissolved in August 1947, though the title was only formally relinquished in June 1948.

zh.t: 英国国王乔治六世发现恶性肿瘤后接受手术，左肺被切除
zh.s: 乔治六世（全名阿尔伯特·弗雷德里克·阿瑟·乔治；1895年12月14日—1952年2月6日）自1936年12月11日起担任英国及英联邦自治领国王，直至1952年去世。1936年至1947年英属印度解体期间，他也是印度皇帝；这一头衔直到1948年6月才正式放弃。

en.t: Richard Nixon delivers the Checkers speech
en.s: Republican vice-presidential candidate Richard Nixon addressed a national television and radio audience after controversy arose over a fund used to reimburse his political expenses. Speaking from Los Angeles, he presented details of his finances and defended his conduct. The address became known for his reference to Checkers, a dog given to his family, which he said they would keep. The public response helped him retain his place alongside Dwight D. Eisenhower on the Republican ticket. The speech became an influential example of a politician using television to make a personal appeal directly to voters during a national campaign.

zh.t: 理查德·尼克松发表“跳棋演说”
zh.s: 共和党副总统候选人理查德·尼克松就一笔用于报销政治开支的基金引发争议，向全国电视和广播观众发表讲话。他在洛杉矶说明自己的财务情况，为自身行为辩护。演说因他提到一只名叫“跳棋”的狗而得名；这只狗是别人送给他家人的，他说一家人会留下它。公众反应帮助尼克松继续与德怀特·艾森豪威尔搭档参选。这场演说成为政治人物通过电视直接向选民陈情的代表案例。

en.s: An indirect presidential election was held in the Parliament of Lebanon in 1952 following the end of Fouad Chehab's military cabinet. The Parliament of Lebanon elected Camille Chamoun, who at that time was an ally of Kamal Jumblatt and a member of the Progressive Socialist Party parliamentary bloc, as the next president of Lebanon on 23 September 1952 to officially succeed Bechara Khoury's term becoming the second president of the Lebanese Republic.

zh.t: 1952年黎巴嫩总统选举
zh.s: 福阿德·谢哈布领导的军政府结束后，黎巴嫩议会于1952年举行间接总统选举。1952年9月23日，议会选举卡米耶·夏蒙为下一任总统，接替任期届满的贝沙拉·胡里。当时，夏蒙是卡迈勒·琼卜拉特的盟友，也是进步社会党议会党团成员。

en.t: After being accused of financial improprieties, Senator Richard Nixon delivers his "Checkers speech" nationwide on television and radio, defending his actions and successfully salvaging his nomination as the Republican candidate for Vice President
en.s: Richard Milhous Nixon (January 9, 1913 – April 22, 1994) was the 37th president of the United States, serving from 1969 until his resignation in 1974. A member of the Republican Party, he represented California in both houses of the United States Congress before serving as the 36th vice president under President Dwight D. Eisenhower from 1953 to 1961.

zh.t: 参议员理查德·尼克松全国电视广播发表“跳棋演说”，为自己辩护并保住共和党副总统候选人提名
zh.s: 理查德·米尔豪斯·尼克松（1913年1月9日—1994年4月22日）是美国第37任总统，1969年至1974年任职，后辞职。他是共和党成员，曾代表加利福尼亚州任职于美国国会两院，并于1953年至1961年担任德怀特·D·艾森豪威尔总统的第36任副总统。

en.t: An all-white jury acquits Emmett Till's killers
en.s: An all-white jury in Sumner, Mississippi, acquitted Roy Bryant and J. W. Milam of murdering fourteen-year-old Emmett Till. The verdict followed a trial that drew national attention to racial violence and the exclusion of Black citizens from equal protection under the law. Till had been abducted and killed in August while visiting relatives in Mississippi. His mother, Mamie Till-Mobley, insisted on an open-casket funeral, making the brutality of his death visible to a wide public. The acquittal, followed by the defendants' later admission of responsibility in a magazine account, became a powerful reference point for the civil rights movement.

zh.t: 全白人陪审团裁定杀害埃米特·蒂尔的凶手无罪
zh.s: 密西西比州萨姆纳的一组全白人陪审员裁定，罗伊·布莱恩特和J·W·米拉姆杀害14岁的埃米特·蒂尔罪名不成立。审判引起全国关注，让人们看到种族暴力以及黑人无法获得平等法律保护的问题。蒂尔8月在密西西比州探亲时遭绑架并被杀。他的母亲玛米·蒂尔-莫布利坚持举行开棺葬礼，让公众直面儿子遭受的暴行。两名被告后来在杂志文章中承认责任。这次无罪判决因此成为民权运动的重要参照。

en.s: The Revolución Libertadora (Spanish pronunciation: [reβoluˈsjon liβeɾtaˈðoɾa]; Liberating Revolution) as it named itself, was the civic-military dictatorship that ruled the Argentine Republic after overthrowing President Juan Domingo Perón, shutting down the National Congress, removing members of the Supreme Court, as well as provincial, municipal, and university authorities, and placing the entire Judiciary under commission. This occurred through a coup d'état on 16 September 1955.

zh.s: 自称“解放革命”的运动，是一场推翻胡安·多明戈·庇隆总统后统治阿根廷的军政独裁政权。该政权通过政变关闭国会，罢免最高法院成员及省、市和大学的主管人员，并将整个司法系统置于特别监管之下。政变发生于1955年9月16日。

en.s: The Kyrenia Castle Escape took place early in the Cyprus Emergency. A number of the EOKA were being held prisoner at Kyrenia Castle and on 23 September 1955, sixteen of them escaped by climbing down sheets tied to be a rope. The escapees were: Marcos Drakos, Christakis Eleftheriou, Evangelos Evangelakis, Mikis Fyrillas, Lambros Kafkallides, Constantinos Loizou, Pavlos Nikitas, Petros Papaioannou, Panayiotis Papanastasiou, Andreas Polyviou, Michalakis Rossides, Lefkios Rodosthenous, Stelios Siamisis, Petros Stylianou, Demos Vryonides, Charilaos Xenofontos.

zh.t: 凯里尼亚城堡越狱
zh.s: 塞浦路斯紧急状态初期，16名被关押在凯里尼亚城堡的塞浦路斯战士组织（EOKA）成员于1955年9月23日越狱。他们把床单结成绳索，从城堡攀爬逃出。越狱者包括马科斯·德拉科斯、赫里斯塔基斯·埃莱夫塞里乌、埃万耶洛斯·埃万耶拉基斯、米基斯·菲里拉斯、兰布罗斯·卡夫卡利季斯、康斯坦蒂诺斯·洛伊祖、帕夫洛斯·尼基塔斯、佩特罗斯·帕帕约阿努、帕纳约蒂斯·帕帕纳斯塔西乌、安德烈亚斯·波利维乌、米哈拉基斯·罗西季斯、莱夫基奥斯·罗多斯塞努斯、斯泰利奥斯·西亚米西斯、佩特罗斯·斯蒂利亚努、德莫斯·弗里奥尼迪斯和哈里拉奥斯·克塞诺丰托斯。

en.t: Flossy strengthens into a hurricane over the Gulf of Mexico
en.s: Flossy became a hurricane over the Gulf of Mexico on September 23, 1956, after moving from the eastern Pacific across Central America and the Yucatán Peninsula. It had become a tropical storm the previous day. The hurricane later reached winds of about 90 miles per hour and struck the central United States Gulf Coast on September 24 as a Category 1 storm. Its effects included flooding around New Orleans and interruptions to offshore oil production; across its course, fifteen people died and damage was estimated at about $24.8 million in 1956 dollars. The coastal landfall belongs to the following day's chronology.

zh.t: 弗洛西在墨西哥湾增强为飓风
zh.s: 1956年9月23日，弗洛西在墨西哥湾增强为飓风；此前一天，它已成为热带风暴。风暴从东太平洋穿过中美洲和尤卡坦半岛，进入墨西哥湾。之后风速达到约每小时90英里，并于9月24日以一级飓风强度袭击美国墨西哥湾中部沿岸。风暴造成新奥尔良附近洪灾，也中断了海上石油生产。整个过程中有15人死亡，损失估计约为2480万美元（按1956年币值计算）。登陆发生在次日，属于9月24日的时间线。

en.s: The 1956 Final was the 69th final of the All-Ireland Senior Hurling Championship and the culmination of the 1956 All-Ireland Senior Hurling Championship, an inter-county hurling tournament for the top teams in Ireland. The match was held at Croke Park, Dublin, on 23 September 1956, between Cork and Wexford. The Munster champions lost to their Leinster opponents on a score line of 2-14 to 2-8.

zh.t: 1956年全爱尔兰高级曲棍球锦标赛决赛
zh.s: 1956年全爱尔兰高级曲棍球锦标赛决赛是该项赛事第69届决赛，也是当年跨郡曲棍球锦标赛的冠军争夺战。1956年9月23日，科克队与韦克斯福德队在都柏林克罗克公园交手。芒斯特冠军科克队以2比14负于伦斯特冠军韦克斯福德队的2比8。

en.t: The Little Rock Nine enter Central High amid mob violence
en.s: Nine Black students entered Little Rock Central High School under police protection as an angry segregationist crowd gathered outside. Threats and violence made it impossible for them to remain safely, and the students were taken out before completing a normal school day. The confrontation followed earlier efforts by Arkansas's governor to prevent their attendance despite federal desegregation orders. President Dwight Eisenhower subsequently placed the Arkansas National Guard under federal control and sent federal troops. Those orders came the next day, and the students returned under military escort on September 25. The episode exposed fierce resistance to implementing school desegregation.
en.n: September 23 marks entry and evacuation; the federal troop order was issued September 24.

zh.t: 小石城九人冒着暴民威胁进入中央高中
zh.s: 9名黑人学生在警方保护下进入小石城中央高中，校外聚集着愤怒的种族隔离主义者。由于威胁和暴力，他们无法安全留在学校，没上完正常的一天课就被带离。此前，阿肯色州州长曾试图阻止他们入学，违抗联邦废除学校种族隔离的命令。之后，德怀特·艾森豪威尔总统将阿肯色州国民警卫队联邦化，并派出联邦军队。这些命令是在次日下达的；9月25日，学生们在军队护送下返校。这场冲突显示，落实学校废除种族隔离政策遭到强烈抵抗。
zh.n: 9月23日是学生入校后被护送离开的日期；联邦出兵令于9月24日下达。

zh.s: 德怀特·戴维·“艾克”·艾森豪威尔（原名戴维·德怀特·艾森豪威尔；1890年10月14日—1969年3月28日）是美国第34任总统，1953年至1961年任职。他此前曾任军职，指挥第二次世界大战期间的盟军远征军，参与北非“火炬行动”和诺曼底登陆“霸王行动”。

zh.t: 墨西哥摔角公司27周年纪念赛
zh.s: 墨西哥自由摔跤公司（EMLL）于1960年9月23日在墨西哥城的墨西哥竞技场举办27周年纪念赛，庆祝公司成立27周年。EMLL后来成为世界上历史最悠久的职业摔角推广公司。周年纪念赛是该公司一年中规模最大的赛事，相当于他们的“超级碗”。

en.s: In August 1960 troops of the Republic of the Congo (presently Democratic Republic of the Congo) attempted to crush the secession of South Kasai by invading the declared state's territory. Though initially militarily successful, the attack faltered under intense international and domestic political scrutiny and the Congolese troops were withdrawn. The Congo became independent in June 1960, and the following month the province of Katanga seceded from the country.

zh.t: 南开赛地区遭入侵
zh.s: 1960年8月，刚果共和国（现刚果民主共和国）军队入侵已宣布脱离的南开赛地区，试图镇压当地分离运动。进攻起初在军事上取得成功，但在国内外的强烈政治审视下受挫，刚果军队随后撤出。刚果于1960年6月独立，次月加丹加省宣布脱离该国。

en.t: U.S. President John F. Kennedy nominates African American civil rights lawyer Thurgood Marshall to the Court of Appeals for the Second Circuit, although pro-segregation Southern senators manage to delay his confirmation until September 11, 1962
en.s: John Fitzgerald Kennedy (May 29, 1917 – November 22, 1963), also known as JFK, was the 35th president of the United States, serving from 1961 until his assassination in 1963. He was the youngest person elected president, at 43 years, and the first Catholic president. Kennedy served at the height of the Cold War, and the majority of his foreign policy concerned relations with the Soviet Union and Cuba.

zh.t: 约翰·F·肯尼迪总统提名非裔美国人民权律师瑟古德·马歇尔出任第二巡回上诉法院法官
zh.s: 约翰·菲茨杰拉德·肯尼迪（1917年5月29日—1963年11月22日），也称JFK，是美国第35任总统，1961年就任，1963年遇刺身亡。他以43岁之龄当选，是当选时最年轻的总统，也是首位天主教总统。肯尼迪执政时期正值冷战高峰，其外交政策大多围绕与苏联和古巴的关系展开。

en.t: The Jetsons introduces a television vision of the future
en.s: The Jetsons premiered on the American television network ABC, presenting a family sitcom set in an imagined future of flying cars, robotic assistance, and elaborate automated homes. Created by William Hanna and Joseph Barbera, the animated series offered a Space Age counterpart to their prehistoric comedy The Flintstones. Its original prime-time run lasted only one season, but repeated broadcasts later made its characters and inventions familiar to generations of viewers. The premiere also marked ABC's first program broadcast in color. The show's lasting cultural importance lies less in accurate prediction than in its playful portrayal of everyday hopes and frustrations about technology.

zh.t: 《杰森一家》呈现电视里的未来生活
zh.s: 美国广播公司（ABC）首播动画情景喜剧《杰森一家》，讲述一个生活在想象未来的家庭，剧中有飞行汽车、机器人帮手和高度自动化的住宅。威廉·汉纳和约瑟夫·巴伯拉创作了这部作品，将它设计成与史前喜剧《摩登原始人》相对应的太空时代故事。最初只播出一季，但之后多次重播，让几代观众熟悉剧中人物和发明。这也是ABC首个彩色播出的节目。《杰森一家》的文化影响力不在于准确预言未来，而在于它用轻松的方式描绘人们对科技的期待，以及日常生活中的烦恼。

en.s: Philharmonic Hall opened at Lincoln Center with a concert featuring Leonard Bernstein and the New York Philharmonic. It was the first completed building in the ambitious performing arts complex on Manhattan's Upper West Side. The opening was televised and introduced audiences to a new home for the orchestra, although reactions to the hall's acoustics were mixed. Attempts to improve the sound led to substantial alterations in later years. The building was subsequently renamed Avery Fisher Hall and then David Geffen Hall. Its opening marked an important stage in the development of Lincoln Center as a major American cultural institution.

zh.t: 林肯中心爱乐大厅开幕
zh.s: 爱乐大厅举行开幕音乐会，由伦纳德·伯恩斯坦和纽约爱乐乐团演出。这是曼哈顿上西区林肯中心艺术综合体中首座完工的建筑。开幕式通过电视播出，为乐团揭开了新音乐厅的序幕，但观众对大厅音响效果的评价不一。之后，为改善音质，建筑进行了大幅改造。该建筑后来先后更名为艾弗里·费雪厅和大卫·格芬厅。大厅开幕标志着林肯中心逐渐发展为美国重要文化机构。

en.t: A transatlantic airliner ditches after engine failures
en.s: Flying Tiger Line Flight 923 ditched in the North Atlantic after a sequence of engine failures and an operating error left the aircraft unable to continue its journey. The Lockheed Super Constellation was carrying military passengers and crew from North America toward West Germany, with a stop at Gander. Its crew attempted to divert toward Shannon before making the emergency water landing. Of the 76 people aboard, 48 survived and were rescued by the merchant ship Celerina after hours on a life raft. The accident became a notable example of survival and rescue during a long-distance oceanic aviation emergency.
en.n: The accident occurred in international waters. Europe is a browsing association with the nearby Irish coast, not a sovereignty claim.

zh.t: 跨大西洋客机因发动机故障迫降海面
zh.s: 飞虎航线923号班机在北大西洋迫降海面。接连发生的发动机故障和一次操作失误使飞机无法继续飞行。这架洛克希德“星座”客机搭载军人和机组人员，从北美飞往西德，途中计划经停甘德。机组曾试图改飞香农，随后在海上紧急迫降。机上76人中有48人生还，数小时后由商船“塞莱丽娜”号救起。事故成为远洋航空紧急事件中生还和救援的典型案例。
zh.n: 事故发生在国际水域。将其与欧洲关联，是因为它靠近爱尔兰海岸；这不表示事故地点属于任何国家。

en.s: The 1962 All-Ireland Senior Football Championship final was the 75th All-Ireland Final and the deciding match of the 1962 All-Ireland Senior Football Championship, an inter-county Gaelic football tournament for the top teams in Ireland. en.t: A sudden squall capsizes fishing boats on Lake Michigan
en.s: A sudden squall struck hundreds of small boats fishing for coho salmon off Michigan's Lake Michigan shore on September 23, 1967. More than 150 boats capsized; seven people died and 46 were injured. Michigan had stocked rivers feeding the lake with coho salmon, and the resulting run had drawn unusually large numbers of anglers onto the water during the state's first coho sport-fishing season. Many were using small craft vulnerable to rapidly changing conditions. The disaster became a stark example of how a short-lived weather event can overwhelm a crowded recreational fleet, even without a major named storm.

zh.t: 突发飑风导致密歇根湖钓鱼船倾覆
zh.s: 1967年9月23日，突发飑风袭击了密歇根州湖岸外数百艘正在捕钓银大麻哈鱼的小船。150多艘船倾覆，造成7人死亡、46人受伤。密歇根州此前在注入湖中的河流放养银大麻哈鱼，鱼群洄游吸引大量垂钓者参加该州首个银大麻哈鱼休闲捕钓季。许多人乘坐的小船经不起迅速变化的天气。这场灾难鲜明地说明，短暂天气突变也能让拥挤的休闲船队陷入危局，即使没有大型命名风暴。

en.s: The Syrian invasion of Jordan began on 18 September 1970 in support of the Palestine Liberation Organization (PLO) amid Black September. Syria conducted a short-lived incursion toward Irbid in northern Jordan, before being forced to withdraw due to heavy casualties. Syria's supposed aim was to help the Palestinian fedayeen overthrow the Hashemite monarchy.

en.t: The Women's Tennis Association was founded in June 1973 by Billie Jean King, Its origins trace back to the inaugural Virginia Slims tournament, which was arranged by Gladys Heldman, sponsored by Joe Cullman, CEO of Philip Morris, and held on 23 September 1970 at the Houston Racquet Club in Houston, Texas
en.s: The Women's Tennis Association (WTA) is the principal organizing body of women's professional tennis. The association governs the WTA Tour, which is the worldwide professional tennis tour for women. The WTA was founded to create a better future for women's tennis. The WTA's corporate headquarters is in St. Petersburg, Florida, with its European headquarters in London and its Asia-Pacific headquarters in Beijing.

zh.t: 女子网球协会成立
zh.s: 女子网球协会（WTA）是女子职业网球的主要管理机构，负责管理WTA巡回赛。该协会于1973年6月由比利·简·金创立，旨在为女子网球创造更好的未来。WTA总部设在佛罗里达州圣彼得堡，欧洲总部位于伦敦，亚太总部位于北京。协会的源头可追溯至1970年9月23日在德克萨斯州休斯敦球拍俱乐部举行的首届弗吉尼亚斯利姆斯赛事；该赛事由格拉迪斯·赫尔德曼筹办、菲利普莫里斯公司首席执行官乔·库尔曼赞助。

en.t: Juan Perón wins Argentina’s presidential election
en.s: Argentine voters elected Juan Domingo Perón president in a special election held after the resignation of Héctor Cámpora. Perón had returned from years of exile following his removal from power in 1955. His wife, Isabel Perón, stood as his running mate and was elected vice president. Their ticket won a clear majority of the vote against opponents including Ricardo Balbín. The result returned Perón to the presidency for a third term, amid serious divisions within the Peronist movement and wider political unrest. The election was a pivotal moment in Argentina's brief and turbulent return to constitutional government during the 1970s.

zh.t: 胡安·庇隆赢得阿根廷总统选举
zh.s: 阿根廷选民在埃克托尔·坎波拉辞职后举行的特别选举中选出胡安·多明戈·庇隆为总统。庇隆在1955年被赶下台后曾流亡多年，之后返回阿根廷。他的妻子伊莎贝尔·庇隆与他搭档参选，并当选副总统。两人以明显多数票击败包括里卡多·巴尔宾在内的对手。庇隆因此第三次出任总统，但庇隆主义运动内部严重分裂，国内也充满政治动荡。这次选举是阿根廷在20世纪70年代短暂而动荡地恢复宪政的关键时刻。

en.t: The BBC begins its Ceefax information service
en.s: The BBC began an experimental Ceefax service, transmitting pages of text through its television signal. Viewers with compatible receivers could select information such as news, weather, and sporting results using numbered pages. The initial service contained only a small collection of pages, but it developed into a familiar source of regularly updated information in British homes. Ceefax was the first teletext information service and preceded widespread household internet access by many years. Its simple display and broadcast delivery made it a distinctive form of on-demand reading. The service continued until the completion of the United Kingdom's digital television transition in 2012.

zh.t: BBC开播Ceefax图文电视服务
zh.s: 英国广播公司（BBC）开始试运行Ceefax服务，通过电视信号传送文字页面。拥有兼容接收器的观众可用数字页码查看新闻、天气和体育赛事结果等信息。最初页面不多，后来逐渐成为英国家庭熟悉的资讯来源。Ceefax是全球首个图文电视服务，早于互联网在家庭普及多年。它通过广播信号提供可按需浏览的简易页面，形成了独特的阅读方式。Ceefax一直运行到2012年英国完成数字电视转换。

en.t: Bob Marley gives his last concert in Pittsburgh
en.s: Bob Marley performed at Pittsburgh's Stanley Theater during the American leg of the Uprising tour. It became his final concert. The Jamaican musician had helped bring reggae to an international audience, combining distinctive rhythms with songs about faith, freedom, inequality, and resistance. He appeared in Pittsburgh despite a serious deterioration in his health, having collapsed in New York only days earlier. The remaining tour dates were canceled as he sought treatment for advanced cancer. Marley died the following year. The concert is remembered as the closing live performance of an artist whose influence extended far beyond Jamaica and the reggae genre.

zh.t: 鲍勃·马利在匹兹堡举行最后一场演唱会
zh.s: 鲍勃·马利在美国“起义”巡演期间，于匹兹堡斯坦利剧院演出。这成为他的最后一场演唱会。这位牙买加音乐人以独特节奏和关于信仰、自由、不平等与反抗的歌曲，让雷鬼乐走向国际舞台。尽管健康状况严重恶化，他仍在匹兹堡登台；几天前，他已在纽约昏倒。之后他取消了剩余巡演，接受晚期癌症治疗，并于次年去世。这场演出是马利最后一次现场演出，他的影响远远超出了牙买加和雷鬼乐界。

en.t: Saint Kitts and Nevis joins the United Nations
en.s: Saint Kitts and Nevis became a member of the United Nations shortly after gaining independence from the United Kingdom. The Security Council had recommended admission the previous day, and membership followed through the General Assembly. The new federation, comprising two Caribbean islands, entered the organization under the name Saint Christopher and Nevis, which remained its United Nations designation for several years. Admission gave the independent state a place in the General Assembly and participation in the organization's international work. September 23 marks United Nations membership, while the country's independence anniversary falls on September 19. These are separate milestones in its transition to sovereignty.
en.n: The admission took place at the UN in New York; the country filter also identifies the admitted state.

zh.t: 圣基茨和尼维斯加入联合国
zh.s: 圣基茨和尼维斯脱离英国独立后不久加入联合国。安理会于前一天建议接纳该国，随后由联合国大会通过。这个由两个加勒比海岛屿组成的新联邦，以“圣克里斯托弗和尼维斯”之名加入联合国；此名称作为该国在联合国的称呼持续了数年。加入联合国使这个独立国家能够参加联合国大会和组织的国际事务。9月23日是加入联合国的日期；该国的独立纪念日则是9月19日。这是迈向主权的两个不同节点。
zh.n: 接纳程序在纽约联合国总部进行；国家筛选标签也标出获接纳的国家。

en.t: A bomb destroys Gulf Air Flight 771
en.s: Gulf Air Flight 771 crashed in the United Arab Emirates after a bomb exploded in its baggage compartment. The Boeing 737 was flying from Karachi to Abu Dhabi and was approaching its destination when the explosion caused a fire. All 105 passengers and seven crew members died. The aircraft came down in the desert near Jebel Ali, between Abu Dhabi and Dubai. Investigations established that the disaster resulted from an intentional bombing rather than an ordinary mechanical failure. The attack has been attributed to the Abu Nidal organization and remains one of the deadliest aviation disasters in the country's history.

zh.t: 炸弹导致海湾航空771号班机坠毁
zh.s: 海湾航空771号班机的行李舱发生炸弹爆炸，飞机随后在阿联酋坠毁。这架波音737当时从卡拉奇飞往阿布扎比，正接近目的地；爆炸引发火灾。机上105名乘客和7名机组人员全部遇难。飞机坠毁在阿布扎比和迪拜之间、杰贝阿里附近的沙漠中。调查确认，这起事故是蓄意爆炸所致，并非普通机械故障。袭击被归咎于阿布·尼达尔组织，是阿联酋历史上伤亡最惨重的空难之一。

en.s: The EMLL 50th Anniversary Show was a professional wrestling major show event produced by Empresa Mexicana de Lucha Libre (EMLL) that took place on September 23, 1983 in Arena México, Mexico City, Mexico. The event commemorated the 50th anniversary of EMLL, which would become the oldest professional wrestling promotion in the world. The Anniversary show is EMLL's biggest show of the year, their Super Bowl event. The main event was the culmination of a long running, intense storyline between Sangre Chicana and MS-1, with both men putting their hair on the line against the outcome of their Lucha de Apuestas, bet match.

zh.t: 墨西哥摔角公司50周年纪念赛
zh.s: 墨西哥自由摔跤公司（EMLL）于1983年9月23日在墨西哥城的墨西哥竞技场举办50周年纪念赛。赛事纪念EMLL成立50周年；该公司后来成为世界上历史最悠久的职业摔角推广公司。周年纪念赛是EMLL一年中规模最大的赛事，相当于公司的“超级碗”。主赛为桑格雷·奇卡纳对阵MS-1，延续了双方长期激烈的剧情，两人以头发作赌注参加“胜负赌注赛”。

en.s: The 1984 All-Ireland Senior Football Championship final was the 97th All-Ireland Final and the deciding match of the 1984 All-Ireland Senior Football Championship, an inter-county Gaelic football tournament for the top teams in Ireland. This was one of six All-Ireland SFC finals contested by both Dublin and Kerry between 1974 and 1986, a period when one of either team always contested the decider.

zh.t: 1984年全爱尔兰高级足球锦标赛决赛
zh.s: 1984年全爱尔兰高级足球锦标赛决赛是第97届全爱尔兰决赛，也是当年跨郡盖尔式足球锦标赛的冠军争夺战。都柏林队与凯里队在1974年至1986年间6次于全爱尔兰高级足球锦标赛决赛交手，这场是其中之一；那段时期每届决赛都有其中一队参加。

en.s: The 1986 Togolese coup d'état attempt was a coup attempt that occurred in the West African country of Togo on 23 September 1986. The coup attempt consisted of a group of some 70 armed dissidents crossed into capital Lomé from Ghana in an unsuccessful attempt to overthrow the government of President General Gnassingbé Eyadéma.

zh.t: 1986年多哥政变未遂
zh.s: 1986年9月23日，一场政变企图在西非国家多哥发生。约70名持械异议人士从加纳越境进入首都洛美，试图推翻格纳辛贝·埃亚德马总统领导的政府，但未能成功。

en.t: José Canseco becomes baseball's first 40–40 player
en.s: Oakland Athletics outfielder José Canseco reached forty stolen bases in a season in which he had already hit forty home runs. He became the first Major League Baseball player to achieve both totals in the same season, establishing what became known as the 40–40 club. The milestone came in a game against the Milwaukee Brewers and combined two skills often associated with different kinds of players: power hitting and aggressive baserunning. Canseco finished the season with forty-two home runs and forty stolen bases. His achievement became a benchmark for later players seeking an exceptional combination of speed and power.

zh.t: 何塞·坎塞科成为大联盟首位“40轰40盗”球员
zh.s: 奥克兰运动家队外野手何塞·坎塞科在单季已击出40支全垒打后，又完成第40次盗垒，成为美国职业棒球大联盟首位单季同时达到40轰和40盗的球员，由此开创“40轰40盗俱乐部”。这一纪录是在对阵密尔沃基酿酒人队的比赛中达成的，结合了通常属于不同类型球员的两项本领：长打和积极跑垒。坎塞科当季最终击出42支全垒打、完成40次盗垒。他的成绩成为后来球员追求速度和力量兼备的标杆。

en.s: Presidential elections were held in the Maldives on 23 September 1988. Maumoon Abdul Gayoom was the sole candidate nominated by Parliament. His candidacy was approved by 96.4% of voters.

zh.t: 1988年马尔代夫总统选举
zh.s: 马尔代夫于1988年9月23日举行总统选举。议会提名毛蒙·阿卜杜勒·加尧姆为唯一候选人，96.4%的选民投票支持他。

en.s: The 1990 All-Ireland Senior Camogie Championship Final, the 59th event of its type, is the culmination of the 1990 All-Ireland Senior Camogie Championship. Wexford did score the first point, but thereafter it was all in favour of Kilkenny with the Downey sisters got 1-9 between them.

zh.t: 1990年全爱尔兰高级女子曲棍球锦标赛决赛
zh.s: 1990年全爱尔兰高级女子曲棍球锦标赛决赛是该项赛事第59届决赛。韦克斯福德队先得1分，此后基尔肯尼队占据上风。唐尼姐妹合计为基尔肯尼队贡献1-9。

en.s: FMW 2nd Anniversary Show: Fall Spectacular (1991) was a professional wrestling event produced by Frontier Martial-Arts Wrestling (FMW). The event took place on September 23, 1991 at the Kawasaki Stadium in Kawasaki, Kanagawa, Japan. This was FMW's first show at the venue and it would become a venue for FMW's future major events. This was the second edition of the company's flagship event Anniversary Show, commemorating the second anniversary of the company.

zh.t: FMW二周年纪念赛：秋季特别赛
zh.s: “FMW二周年纪念赛：秋季特别赛”是日本职业摔角联盟FMW举办的一场赛事，于1991年9月23日在神奈川县川崎市的川崎体育场举行。这是FMW首次在该场馆办赛，此后该场馆成为公司举办大型赛事的地点之一。这也是公司旗舰周年纪念赛系列的第二届，用以纪念FMW成立两周年。

en.s: The 1991 New Brunswick general election was held on September 23, 1991, to elect 58 members to the 52nd New Brunswick Legislative Assembly, the governing house of the province of New Brunswick, Canada. As expected, the Liberal Party won a large majority. Many were surprised that the Confederation of Regions Party formed the official opposition.

zh.t: 1991年新不伦瑞克省大选
zh.s: 加拿大新不伦瑞克省于1991年9月23日举行大选，选出省议会第52届议会的58名议员。正如外界预期，自由党赢得大多数席位；出人意料的是，地区联盟党成为官方反对党。

en.t: Sydney wins the vote to host the 2000 Olympics
en.s: The International Olympic Committee selected Sydney to host the 2000 Summer Olympics at its session in Monte Carlo. Sydney defeated Beijing in the final round by forty-five votes to forty-three, after other shortlisted cities had been eliminated. The result set in motion years of preparation for the Games in Australia, including construction and redevelopment around the Olympic precinct. It was a host-city decision, not the opening of the competition itself. The announcement occurred on September 23 in Monaco, while celebrations in Sydney took place early on September 24 because of the time difference. The Games were held seven years later.
en.n: September 23 in Monaco was already September 24 in Sydney; Australia is indexed as the awarded host location.

zh.t: 悉尼赢得2000年奥运会主办权投票
zh.s: 国际奥委会在摩纳哥举行的会议上选定悉尼主办2000年夏季奥运会。最后一轮投票中，悉尼以45票对43票击败北京，其他入围城市此前已被淘汰。决定公布后，澳大利亚开始多年筹备，包括兴建奥运场馆并改造奥运园区周边地区。这一天是主办城市的选定日，并非奥运会开幕日。摩纳哥于9月23日宣布结果；由于时差，悉尼的庆祝活动已是当地9月24日凌晨。奥运会于7年后举行。
zh.n: 摩纳哥的9月23日对应悉尼当地的9月24日；澳大利亚是获选主办地。

en.s: The Battle of Newry Road was a running gun battle between British helicopters and Provisional Irish Republican Army (IRA) armed trucks, fought along the lanes east of Crossmaglen, County Armagh, on 23 September 1993. The engagement began when an IRA team from the South Armagh Brigade attempted to ambush three helicopters lifting off from Crossmaglen barracks.

zh.t: 纽里路战役
zh.s: 1993年9月23日，英国军用直升机与爱尔兰共和军临时派系的武装卡车在阿尔马郡克罗斯马格伦以东的道路上发生移动枪战。战斗起因是爱尔兰共和军南阿尔马旅一支小队试图伏击3架正从克罗斯马格伦军营起飞的直升机。

en.s: Blackjack Brawl was the first and only major live television supercard event produced by Herb Abrams' Universal Wrestling Federation (UWF). The event took place on September 23, 1994 at the MGM Grand Garden Arena in Paradise, Nevada and aired live on SportsChannel America. The event was a successor to UWF's only pay-per-view event, Beach Brawl. Eleven professional wrestling matches were contested on the card.

zh.t: UWF“黑杰克乱斗”赛事
zh.s: “黑杰克乱斗”是赫伯·艾布拉姆斯创办的环球摔角联盟（UWF）制作的首场、也是唯一一场大型电视直播赛事。比赛于1994年9月23日在内华达州天堂市的米高梅大花园竞技场举行，由SportsChannel America现场直播。这是UWF唯一一场付费电视赛事“海滩乱斗”的后续赛事，共安排11场职业摔角比赛。

en.t: Qantas Flight 1 overruns a runway in Bangkok
en.s: A Qantas Boeing 747 operating Flight 1 overran the runway while landing at Bangkok's Don Mueang airport during a journey from Sydney to London. The aircraft was making a scheduled stop in heavy rain, and its landing and braking performance left insufficient distance to stop before the runway ended. All 410 people aboard survived, although passengers and crew suffered injuries during the accident and evacuation. The aircraft sustained major damage. The subsequent investigation examined the landing decisions, wet-runway conditions, and airline procedures. The event became an important case in discussions of runway overruns and the management of approaches in adverse weather.

zh.t: 澳航1号班机在曼谷冲出跑道
zh.s: 一架执行澳航1号班机的波音747客机从悉尼飞往伦敦，在曼谷廊曼机场降落时冲出跑道。飞机在大雨中按计划经停，着陆和制动情况使机组来不及在跑道尽头前停下。机上410人全部生还，但乘客和机组人员在事故及疏散过程中受伤，飞机严重受损。后续调查检视了降落决策、湿滑跑道状况和航空公司程序。这起事故成为研究飞机冲出跑道以及恶劣天气下进场管理的重要案例。

en.t: Contact with Mars Climate Orbiter is lost
en.s: NASA lost contact with Mars Climate Orbiter during its attempted arrival in orbit around Mars. The spacecraft had been sent to study the planet's climate and atmosphere and to support communications for another mission. An investigation identified a mismatch between measurement units in ground software: one system supplied impulse data in pound-force seconds while another expected newton-seconds. The resulting navigation errors brought the spacecraft dangerously close to Mars. The failure became a widely studied engineering case, illustrating the importance of consistent interfaces, independent checks, and the handling of warning signs across teams responsible for a complex space mission.
en.n: The event happened at Mars; the location filter identifies the mission’s Earth-based operations.

zh.t: 火星气候轨道器失去联络
zh.s: NASA的火星气候轨道器在尝试进入火星轨道时失去联络。探测器原本用于研究火星气候和大气，并为另一项任务提供通信支持。调查发现，地面软件使用的测量单位不一致：一个系统提供的冲量数据单位是磅力秒，另一个系统却按牛顿秒处理。由此产生的导航误差使探测器过于接近火星。此次任务失败成为工程领域广为研究的案例，说明接口单位必须一致、需要独立检查，也要重视复杂任务中团队发现的警示信号。
zh.n: 事件发生在火星；地点筛选标签指的是任务在地球上的运行中心。

en.s: Direct presidential elections were held in Yemen for the first time on 23 September 1999. Candidates had to be approved by at least 10% of the 301 members of the House of Representatives; however, in practice this meant that only two parties, the ruling General People's Congress (GPC) and Al-Islah had enough seats to nominate their candidates. However, al-Islah backed the GPC candidate, incumbent President Ali Abdullah Saleh rather than running a candidate of their own. The only candidates that received approval from Parliament were Saleh and Najeeb Qahtan Al-Sha'abi, another member of the GPC.

zh.t: 也门总统选举（1999年）
zh.s: 1999年9月23日，也门首次举行直接总统选举。候选人必须获得众议院301名议员中至少10%的支持才能参选；实际上，只有执政的全国人民大会党和伊斯兰改革集团拥有足够议席提名候选人。不过，伊斯兰改革集团支持了全国人民大会党候选人、时任总统阿里·阿卜杜拉·萨利赫，没有另提人选。议会批准参选的只有萨利赫和全国人民大会党成员纳吉布·卡赫坦·沙比。

en.s: A by-election for the United Kingdom parliamentary constituency of Hamilton South was held on 23 September 1999, following the resignation of incumbent Labour Party MP George Robertson upon his appointment as Secretary General of NATO. It was won by Bill Tynan, who held seat for Labour. On 4 August 1999, incumbent MP George Robertson was announced as the new NATO Secretary General.

zh.t: 1999年汉密尔顿南选区补选
zh.s: 英国汉密尔顿南议会选区于1999年9月23日举行补选。原工党议员乔治·罗伯逊获任北约秘书长后辞去议员职务，补选由比尔·泰南获胜，继续为工党保住该席位。罗伯逊于同年8月4日被宣布为新任北约秘书长。

en.s: A by-election for the United Kingdom parliamentary constituency of Wigan was held on 23 September 1999 following the death of incumbent Labour Party MP Roger Stott. Neil Turner, who had been a local Labour councillor for 27 years, held the seat for the party. The by-election was contested by nine candidates in total. The Conservatives chose Tom Peet, who was an active Trade Unionist and had worked at a nearby coal mine.

zh.t: 1999年威根选区补选
zh.s: 英国威根议会选区于1999年9月23日举行补选。原工党议员罗杰·斯托特去世后，选民投票选出新议员。曾担任当地工党议员27年的尼尔·特纳为工党保住该席位。共有9名候选人参选，保守党提名了曾在附近煤矿工作、积极参与工会活动的汤姆·皮特。

en.s: There was a Scottish National Party leadership election to choose the new National Convener of the Scottish National Party (SNP) in 2000. The election followed the announcement by SNP Leader Alex Salmond, that he would be stepping down as SNP leader in 2000. Salmond's announcement came in the face of internal criticism after a series of high-profile fall-outs with party members.

zh.t: 2000年苏格兰民族党党魁选举
zh.s: 苏格兰民族党于2000年举行选举，选出新任全国召集人。此前，党魁亚历克斯·萨尔蒙德宣布将于当年辞去党魁职务。他是在与党内成员发生一系列引人注目的冲突、受到党内批评后作出这一决定。
