en.t: Macau holds its first legislative election after the handover
en.s: Voters in Macau elected representatives to the Legislative Assembly in the first legislative election held after the territory became a Chinese special administrative region in 1999. Ten of the assembly's twenty-seven seats were filled by direct popular election, alongside seats chosen through other methods. Competing electoral associations represented different political and social interests, and several lists gained representation. The poll was an important stage in the development of Macau's post-handover institutions under its Basic Law. It should not be described as an election of the entire legislature by universal vote, because directly elected members constituted only part of the assembly.

zh.t: 澳门举行回归后的首次立法会选举
zh.s: 澳门于1999年成为中国特别行政区后，首次举行立法会选举。立法会27个议席中有10席由直选产生，其余席位通过其他方式选出。不同选举团体代表各类政治和社会利益，多张参选名单赢得议席。这次投票是澳门根据《基本法》发展回归后制度的重要一步。不能把它说成全体立法会议员都由普选产生，因为直选议员只占部分席位。

en.s: The 2001 Polish parliamentary election was held on 23 September 2001 to elect deputies to both houses of the National Assembly. The election concluded with an overwhelming victory for the centre-left Democratic Left Alliance – Labor Union, the electoral coalition between both the Democratic Left Alliance (SLD) and the Labour Union (UP), which captured 41% of the vote in the crucial lower house Sejm. The 2001 election is recognized as marking the emergence of both Civic Platform (PO) and Law and Justice (PiS) as players in Polish politics, while also witnessing the outright collapse of the Solidarity Electoral Action (AWS) and its former coalition partner, the Freedom Union (UW).

zh.t: 波兰议会选举（2001年）
zh.s: 波兰于2001年9月23日举行议会选举，选出国民大会两院议员。由民主左翼联盟和劳动联盟组成的中左翼选举联盟以压倒性优势获胜，在关键的众议院获得41%的选票。此次选举标志着公民纲领党和法律与公正党开始成为波兰政坛的重要力量；团结选举行动和其前执政伙伴自由联盟则遭遇惨败。

en.s: The Hamburg state election, 2001, was conducted on September 23, 2001, to elect members to the Hamburgische Bürgerschaft (state and city legislature) of Hamburg. It was the 17th legislative period of the parliament.

zh.t: 2001年汉堡州选举
zh.s: 汉堡于2001年9月23日举行州选举，选出汉堡市州议会（汉堡议会）第17届议员。

en.s: The 2001 Unforgiven was a professional wrestling pay-per-view (PPV) event produced by the World Wrestling Federation (WWF, now WWE). It was the fourth annual Unforgiven and took place on September 23, 2001, at the Mellon Arena in Pittsburgh, Pennsylvania. zh.t: 《无赦》（2001年）摔角大赛
zh.s: 2001年《无赦》是世界摔角联盟（WWF，现WWE）举办的付费电视摔角大赛，也是“无赦”系列第4届，于2001年9月23日在宾夕法尼亚州匹兹堡的梅隆竞技场举行。这是品牌分立制于2002年3月推出前的最后一届“无赦”，也是WWF更名为世界摔角娱乐（WWE）前最后一届以WWF名义举办的赛事；该公司于2002年5月更名。

en.s: The 2001 All-Ireland Senior Football Championship final was the 114th All-Ireland Final and the deciding match of the 2001 All-Ireland Senior Football Championship (SFC), an inter-county Gaelic football tournament for the top teams in Ireland. zh.t: 2001年全爱尔兰高级足球锦标赛决赛
zh.s: 2001年全爱尔兰高级足球锦标赛决赛是第114届全爱尔兰决赛，也是当年跨郡盖尔式足球锦标赛的冠军争夺战。戈尔韦队击败米斯队。直到2022年戈尔韦队在半决赛击败德里队之前，两队都没有再次打进决赛。

en.t: Phoenix 0.1 begins the browser project later named Firefox
en.s: Mozilla developers released Phoenix 0.1, an early standalone web browser that would later be renamed Firefox. The project sought to provide a more focused browsing application than the larger Mozilla suite, which combined browsing with other internet tools. Its first public version allowed users and developers to test that approach and contribute feedback. Phoenix subsequently changed names before Firefox reached its widely publicized 1.0 release in 2004. The September anniversary therefore marks the initial Phoenix release, rather than the launch of Firefox 1.0. It is an early milestone in the growth of an open-source alternative within the browser market.
en.n: This was an online software release; the country identifies the US-based Mozilla project, not every contributor's location.

zh.t: Phoenix 0.1发布，开启后来更名为Firefox的浏览器项目
zh.s: Mozilla开发者发布了早期独立浏览器Phoenix 0.1，后来该项目更名为Firefox。开发团队希望提供一个比Mozilla大型套件更专注的浏览器；Mozilla套件当时还整合了其他互联网工具。首个公开版本让用户和开发者试用这一方案并提供反馈。Phoenix后来又改过名称，Firefox 1.0则于2004年广泛宣传后正式发布。因此，9月的纪念日对应Phoenix最初发布，而不是Firefox 1.0问世。这是开源浏览器成长为市场重要竞争者的早期节点。
zh.n: 这是一次在线软件发布；地点标签指出Mozilla项目来自美国，不代表每位贡献者都身在美国。

en.t: United Malays National Organisation leadership election, 2004
en.s: A leadership election was held by the United Malays National Organisation (UMNO) party on 23 September 2004. It was won by incumbent Prime Minister and acting President of UMNO, Abdullah Ahmad Badawi.

zh.t: 2004年马来民族统一机构党魁选举
zh.s: 马来民族统一机构（巫统，UMNO）于2004年9月23日举行党魁选举。时任马来西亚总理、代理巫统主席阿卜杜拉·艾哈迈德·巴达维当选。

zh.t: 2005年阿鲁巴大选
zh.s: 阿鲁巴于2005年9月23日举行大选。人民选举运动党赢得选举，在议会21个席位中取得11席。

en.s: The CMLL International Gran Prix (2005) was a lucha libre, or professional wrestling, tournament produced and scripted by the Mexican professional wrestling promotion Consejo Mundial de Lucha Libre (CMLL; "World Wrestling Council" in Spanish) which took place on September 23, 2005 in Arena México, Mexico City, Mexico, CMLL's main venue. The 2005 International Gran Prix was the eight time CMLL has held an International Gran Prix tournament since 1994.

zh.t: 2005年CMLL国际大奖赛
zh.s: 2005年CMLL国际大奖赛是墨西哥摔角推广公司世界摔角理事会（CMLL）制作的一场摔角自由式比赛，于2005年9月23日在墨西哥城的墨西哥竞技场举行。自1994年以来，这是CMLL第8次举办国际大奖赛。

en.s: Estonian presidential elections, 2006 took place over four rounds, which were held on 28 and 29 August, and 23 September 2006. The first three rounds of presidential elections was held within the Riigikogu, which was Estonia's Parliament, as specified under electoral law. Although there was only one candidate per round in the three rounds, those being Ene Ergma in the first round and Toomas Hendrik Ilves in the second and third rounds, they were not elected as these candidates did not obtain the required two-thirds of the votes in the Riigikogu.

zh.t: 2006年爱沙尼亚总统选举
zh.s: 2006年爱沙尼亚总统选举分4轮举行，投票日期为8月28日、29日和9月23日。前三轮在爱沙尼亚议会里吉科古举行。依照选举法，这三轮每轮只有一名候选人：埃内·埃尔格马参加第一轮，托马斯·亨德里克·伊尔韦斯参加第二、三轮。但他们都没有获得议会规定的三分之二多数，因而未能当选。

zh.t: UFC 63格斗赛
zh.s: UFC 63：“休斯对佩恩”是一场综合格斗赛事，由终极格斗冠军赛于2006年9月23日举办。比赛在加利福尼亚州阿纳海姆的箭头池体育馆举行，并通过付费电视在美国和加拿大直播。

en.s: A by-election for the seat of Stuart in the Northern Territory Legislative Assembly was held on 23 September 2006. The by-election was triggered by the resignation of Labor member Peter Toyne, the Minister for Health, on 29 August 2006 due to ill health. The seat had been held by the Labor Party since 1983, with Toyne as the member since 1996.

zh.t: 2006年斯图尔特选区补选
zh.s: 澳大利亚北领地立法议会斯图尔特选区于2006年9月23日举行补选。工党议员兼卫生部长彼得·托因因健康问题于8月29日辞职，触发补选。该席位自1983年以来一直由工党持有，托因自1996年起担任该选区议员。

en.s: The Ramadan Offensive refers to the attacks mounted by insurgents in Iraq during the holy Muslim month of Ramadan in 2006, three years after the original Ramadan Offensive. Among the targets were U.S., Iraqi and other Coalition military targets, but many civilians were also killed by death squads. Most of the civilian killings were conducted by the Mahdi Army who were seeking to purge the Sunni population of Baghdad.

zh.t: 斋月攻势（2006年）
zh.s: 2006年穆斯林斋月期间，伊拉克叛乱组织发动了一系列袭击，称为“斋月攻势”，这是2003年首次“斋月攻势”后三年发生的同名行动。袭击目标包括美国、伊拉克和其他联军军事力量，但死亡小队也杀害了许多平民。多数针对平民的杀戮由迈赫迪军实施，该组织当时试图清除巴格达的逊尼派居民。

en.s: The 2007 Liberal Democratic Party presidential election was held on 23 September 2007 after the incumbent party leader and Prime Minister of Japan Shinzo Abe announced that he would resign on 12 September 2007. Abe had only been elected to the post slightly less than a year earlier; his resignation came only three days after a new parliamentary session had begun.

zh.t: 2007年日本自民党总裁选举
zh.s: 日本自民党于2007年9月23日举行总裁选举。时任党总裁兼首相安倍晋三于9月12日宣布辞职；他当选总裁还不到一年，辞职时距离新一届国会开议仅3天。

en.t: 2007 All-Ireland Senior Ladies' Football Championship final
en.s: The 2007 All-Ireland Senior Ladies' Football Championship Final featured Cork and Mayo. Cork completed a three in a row of All-Ireland titles. Valerie Mulcahy scored 2–1 as Cork won 2–11 to 2–6. Mulcahy scored her first goal from the penalty spot just before half time. The decision to award the penalty was described as "questionable" and was only confirmed after the referee, Eugene O'Hare, consulted with his umpires.

zh.t: 2007年全爱尔兰高级女子足球锦标赛决赛
zh.s: 2007年全爱尔兰高级女子足球锦标赛决赛由科克队对阵梅奥队。科克队完成全爱尔兰冠军三连冠，瓦莱丽·马尔卡希个人攻入2球、贡献1次助攻，科克队以2-11比2-6取胜。马尔卡希在上半场结束前罚进一粒点球。裁判尤金·奥黑尔与边裁商议后才判罚点球；这项判罚被认为“有争议”。

en.t: The first commercial Android phone is unveiled
en.s: HTC and its partners introduced the Dream, marketed in the United States as the T-Mobile G1, as the first commercial smartphone to run Android. The device combined a touchscreen with a slide-out physical keyboard and integrated services associated with Google's mobile software platform. Its announcement introduced the public to a new competitor in a smartphone market already shaped by established handset makers and Apple's iPhone. Sales began later, so September 23 records the unveiling rather than the first retail purchase. The phone became the starting point for the commercial Android device ecosystem, which subsequently expanded across many manufacturers and product designs.

zh.t: 首款商用安卓手机亮相
zh.s: HTC及其合作伙伴发布HTC Dream。在美国，这款手机以T-Mobile G1的名称销售，是首款运行安卓系统的商用智能手机。它结合了触摸屏、滑出式实体键盘和谷歌移动软件平台的相关服务。发布后，智能手机市场多了一位新竞争者，当时市场已由成熟手机厂商和苹果iPhone主导。手机之后才开始销售，因此9月23日是产品亮相日，而非首次零售日。它为后来由众多厂商和机型组成的安卓商用设备生态打下了基础。

en.t: A school shooting kills ten people in Kauhajoki
en.s: A student attacked a school in Kauhajoki, western Finland, killing ten people before fatally shooting himself. The victims included students and a staff member, and the attack also involved fires inside the building. It followed the previous year's school shooting at Jokela and prompted renewed national debate over firearm licensing, school safety, and the handling of warning signs. Police had interviewed the attacker before the shooting after concerning material appeared online, but had not removed his weapon. Later investigations examined the decisions made by authorities and recommended changes. The anniversary commemorates the victims and a major tragedy in Finland's recent history.

zh.t: 考哈约基校园枪击案造成10人死亡
zh.s: 芬兰西部考哈约基一名学生在学校发动袭击，杀害10人后开枪自杀。遇难者包括学生和一名教职员工，校内还发生了火灾。此前一年约凯拉发生校园枪击案，这起事件再度引发芬兰全国对枪支持证、校园安全和预警处理的讨论。警方此前因网上出现令人担忧的内容而问询过袭击者，但没有收走他的枪。后续调查审查了相关部门的决定并提出改进建议。这一天，人们纪念受害者，也纪念芬兰近代史上的重大悲剧。

en.s: Dream 6: Middle Weight Grandprix 2008 Final Round was a mixed martial arts event promoted by Fighting and Entertainment Group's mixed martial arts promotion Dream on September 23, 2008. The event hosted the crowning of Dream's first Middleweight Champion, Gegard Mousasi, after the conclusion of the Middleweight Grand Prix.

zh.t: Dream 6：2008年中量级大奖赛决赛轮
zh.s: Dream 6：2008年中量级大奖赛决赛轮是由Fighting and Entertainment Group旗下Dream综合格斗赛事于2008年9月23日举办的一场比赛。中量级大奖赛结束后，格加德·穆萨西成为Dream首位中量级冠军。

en.t: Virginia executes Teresa Lewis amid clemency debate
en.s: Teresa Lewis was executed by lethal injection in Virginia after being convicted for arranging the murders of her husband and stepson. She became the first woman executed in the state since 1912. Her case attracted international attention and appeals for clemency, with supporters questioning her intellectual capacity and comparing her sentence with the life sentences received by the men who carried out the killings. Courts and executive authorities allowed the execution to proceed. The event became part of wider debate over capital punishment, the treatment of defendants with cognitive limitations, and the consistency of sentencing among participants in the same crime.

zh.t: 弗吉尼亚州处决特蕾莎·刘易斯，引发赦免争议
zh.s: 特蕾莎·刘易斯因安排杀害丈夫和继子的案件被判有罪，随后在弗吉尼亚州接受注射处决。她是该州自1912年以来首位被处决的女性。此案引起国际关注，也有人呼吁赦免；支持者质疑她的认知能力，并将她的死刑与实施杀人的男性同伙所获的终身监禁相比较。法院和州政府最终允许执行死刑。这起事件引发了更广泛的讨论，包括死刑、对认知能力受限被告的对待，以及同案参与者判刑是否一致。

en.s: The Leyenda de Plata (2011) was professional wrestling tournament produced by the Mexican wrestling promotion Consejo Mundial de Lucha Libre (CMLLl; Spanish "World Wrestling Council") that ran from September 23, 2011, over the course of three of CMLL's Friday night shows in Arena México with the finals on October 7, 2011. The annual Leyenda de Plata tournament is held in honor of lucha libre legend El Santo and is one of CMLL's most important annual tournaments.

zh.t: 2011年“白银传奇”摔角赛
zh.s: 2011年“白银传奇”是墨西哥摔角推广公司世界摔角理事会（CMLL）举办的职业摔角锦标赛。赛事从9月23日开始，在墨西哥竞技场举行了3场周五晚间比赛，并于10月7日决出冠军。“白银传奇”每年举办一次，纪念摔角传奇人物埃尔·桑托，是CMLL最重要的年度赛事之一。

en.s: The 2012 All-Ireland Football Championship final, the 125th event of its kind and the culmination of the 2012 All-Ireland Senior Football Championship, was played at Croke Park, Dublin, on 23 September 2012. Donegal and Mayo, widely considered "one of the most novel final pairings of all time", met to decide the destination of the Sam Maguire Cup, with Donegal ultimately emerging victorious as Mayo were yet again undone by "the curse".

zh.t: 2012年全爱尔兰高级足球锦标赛决赛
zh.s: 2012年全爱尔兰高级足球锦标赛决赛是该项赛事第125届决赛，于2012年9月23日在都柏林克罗克公园举行。多尼戈尔队与梅奥队争夺萨姆·马奎尔杯；这组对阵被不少人称为“历来最出人意料的决赛组合之一”。多尼戈尔队最终获胜，梅奥队再次被所谓的“魔咒”击败。

zh.s: 阿布杜胡尔空军基地围城战是叙利亚内战期间围绕伊德利卜省该基地展开的战斗。基地自2012年9月起遭围困，最终于2015年9月9日被叛军和圣战组织武装攻占。

en.s: The 2014 Quneitra offensive, code-named “The Real Promise” or "Chargers of Dawn", was a military operation launched by Syrian rebels during the Syrian civil war in Quneitra Governorate, in an attempt to take control of several sections in the central part of the province and around Quneitra city "with the aim of opening the way to Damascus." zh.s: 2014年库奈特拉攻势又称“真正的承诺”或“黎明突击队”，是叙利亚内战期间叙利亚反政府武装发动的一次军事行动，试图控制库奈特拉省中部多个区域及库奈特拉市周边地区，目标是“打开通往大马士革的道路”。库奈特拉过境点被视为从西面进入大马士革的“门户”。

zh.s: Brave 1：开端（也称Brave 1或“Brave：开端”）是勇士格斗联盟于2016年9月23日周五在巴林伊萨城哈利法体育城举办的综合格斗赛事。赛事通过网络和巴林电视台现场直播。

en.s: The 2017 New Zealand general election took place on Saturday 23 September 2017 to determine the membership of the 52nd New Zealand Parliament. The previous parliament was elected on 20 September 2014 and was officially dissolved on 22 August 2017. Voters elected 120 members to the House of Representatives under New Zealand's mixed-member proportional (MMP) voting system, a proportional representation system in which 71 members were elected from single-member electorates and 49 members were elected from closed party lists.

zh.t: 2017年新西兰大选
zh.s: 新西兰于2017年9月23日举行大选，选出第52届新西兰议会议员。上届议会于2014年9月20日选出，并于2017年8月22日正式解散。选民按照混合成员比例代表制，选出120名众议院议员，其中71人来自单议员选区，49人通过封闭名单产生。

en.t: Hong Kong's high-speed rail connection opens to passengers
en.s: Passenger services began on the Hong Kong section of the Guangzhou–Shenzhen–Hong Kong Express Rail Link. The new connection brought trains from West Kowloon into the mainland high-speed railway network, completing a route whose mainland sections had opened earlier. Travelers could make direct journeys toward Shenzhen, Guangzhou, and more distant destinations without changing between separate rail systems at the border. The project's construction, cost, and arrangements for border checks had generated extensive public discussion. September 23 marks the beginning of public service, following an inauguration ceremony the day before. West Kowloon became Hong Kong's gateway to the connected high-speed network.
en.n: Public service began September 23; the inauguration ceremony took place September 22.

zh.t: 香港高铁开通客运服务
zh.s: 广深港高速铁路香港段开始提供客运服务。新线路从西九龙连接内地高铁网络，补上此前已开通的内地路段。旅客可从香港直接前往深圳、广州及更远地区，无须在边境换乘不同铁路系统。工程建设、成本和口岸查验安排曾引起广泛讨论。9月23日是正式载客日，前一天已举行开通仪式。西九龙站由此成为香港接入高铁网络的门户。
zh.n: 客运服务于9月23日开始；开通仪式在9月22日举行。

en.s: Presidential elections were held in the Maldives on Sunday, 23 September 2018. Incumbent president Abdulla Yameen of the Progressive Party of Maldives (PPM) was seeking re-election for a second five-year term. His only challenger was Ibrahim Mohamed Solih of the Maldivian Democratic Party (MDP), who was nominated as the joint candidate of a coalition of opposition parties.

zh.t: 2018年马尔代夫总统选举
zh.s: 马尔代夫于2018年9月23日星期日举行总统选举。时任总统、马尔代夫进步党候选人阿卜杜拉·亚明寻求连任第二个五年任期。他唯一的对手是马尔代夫民主党候选人易卜拉欣·穆罕默德·索利赫；索利赫由多个反对党组成的联盟共同提名。

en.s: Yerevan City Council elections were held on 23 September 2018. The snap election was triggered after the resignation of former mayor Taron Margaryan amid the aftermath of the 2018 Armenian Velvet Revolution. Well-known comedian and actor Hayk Marutyan, heading the electoral list of the My Step Alliance, was elected to the office of mayor of Yerevan.

zh.t: 2018年埃里温市议会选举
zh.s: 埃里温于2018年9月23日举行市议会选举。前市长塔隆·马尔加良在2018年亚美尼亚天鹅绒革命后辞职，促成了这次提前选举。“我的一步”联盟名单由知名喜剧演员兼演员海克·马鲁强领衔，他随后当选埃里温市长。

en.s: The 2018 Khabarovsk Krai gubernatorial election was held in September 2018. The first round was held on 9 September, on common election day, with none of the candidates gaining an absolute majority (50% + 1 vote), causing a run-off vote. The second round was held on 23 September, between the top two candidates, the Liberal Democratic candidate Sergei Furgal and the incumbent Governor Vyacheslav Shport, nominated by the United Russia.

en.t: Thomas Cook collapses after rescue talks fail
en.s: Thomas Cook Group entered compulsory liquidation after efforts to secure a financial rescue failed. The British travel business and its UK airline stopped operating, disrupting holidays and leaving large numbers of travelers overseas. British authorities organized a major repatriation effort to bring customers home, while employees faced sudden uncertainty about their jobs. The collapse reflected a combination of heavy debt and difficulties adapting to changes in the travel market. It did not mean every business worldwide using the Thomas Cook name ceased trading, because some were separately owned or later acquired. The event marked the end of the group's operations in their existing form.

zh.t: 救援谈判失败，托马斯·库克集团破产清算
zh.s: 英国旅游集团托马斯·库克未能获得资金救助，进入强制清算程序。集团旗下英国旅游业务和航空公司停止运营，假期行程被打乱，大批旅客滞留海外。英国政府组织大规模遣返行动，接回受影响的旅客；员工则突然面临失业风险。集团倒闭与债务沉重、难以适应旅游市场变化等因素有关。这不表示全球所有使用“托马斯·库克”名称的企业都停止营业，因为其中一些企业由其他公司独立持有或后来被收购。这标志着该集团以原有形式运营的终结。

en.t: 2021 Green Party of England and Wales leadership election
en.s: The 2021 Green Party of England and Wales leadership election was held from August to September 2021 to select a new leader or leaders of the Green Party of England and Wales. It was triggered by Jonathan Bartley's announcement on 5 July 2021 that he would be standing down as party co-leader. Bartley had been co-leader of the party since 2016, initially serving with the party's Member of Parliament (MP) Caroline Lucas.

en.t: Russian occupation authorities begin annexation votes in Ukraine
en.s: Russian occupation authorities began votes on joining Russia in occupied parts of Ukraine's Donetsk, Luhansk, Kherson, and Zaporizhzhia regions. The voting took place during Russia's invasion and continued over five days. Ukraine and many other governments rejected the process as illegitimate, citing military occupation, coercion, and the absence of conditions for a free expression of public opinion. Russia subsequently used the announced results to claim annexation of the four regions. Those claims did not establish internationally recognized Russian sovereignty. September 23 marks the beginning of the voting process; the later annexation announcement and international responses occurred on different dates.
en.n: Voting ran September 23–27. The locations remain indexed as Ukrainian territory under Russian occupation.

zh.t: 俄罗斯占领当局在乌克兰开始所谓“入俄公投”

zh.n: 投票从9月23日持续至27日。相关地点仍按国际承认的乌克兰领土标注，同时说明处于俄军占领之下。

en.t: The postponed Hangzhou Asian Games officially open
en.s: The Asian Games officially opened in Hangzhou, China, with a ceremony at the city's principal stadium. Although staged in 2023, the event retained the name Hangzhou 2022 after being postponed because of the COVID-19 pandemic. Athletes representing forty-five National Olympic Committees participated in a program spanning dozens of sports. The Games continued into October and included both longstanding competitions and newer medal disciplines such as esports. Hangzhou became the third Chinese city to host the Asian Games, following Beijing and Guangzhou. September 23 marks the opening ceremony, while some competitions had already begun before the formal opening.
en.n: The Games retained the 2022 branding but opened on September 23, 2023.

en.s: Israel launched a major wave of airstrikes across Lebanon as fighting with Hezbollah escalated sharply. The attacks struck southern areas and the Beqaa Valley, killed hundreds of people, and drove large numbers of civilians to flee. Israel said it was targeting Hezbollah's military capabilities, while humanitarian organizations documented the extensive toll on civilians, including children. Hospitals and emergency services faced rapidly rising needs, and schools were used as shelters. The strikes followed earlier cross-border exchanges and attacks on communication devices. September 23 marks the opening of this intensified air campaign, rather than the beginning of the broader conflict or all its subsequent casualties.

zh.t: 以色列对黎巴嫩发动大规模空袭
zh.s: 以色列与真主党的战斗急剧升级，随后对黎巴嫩多地发动一轮大规模空袭。袭击波及黎巴嫩南部和贝卡谷地，造成数百人死亡，大批平民逃离家园。以色列称打击目标是真主党的军事能力；人道组织记录了包括儿童在内的平民伤亡。医院和急救服务面对迅速增加的需求，学校被用作避难所。空袭之前，双方已有跨境交火，通信设备也曾遭袭。9月23日标志着这轮升级空袭开始，并非更广泛冲突的开端，也不代表之后全部伤亡都发生在这一天。

en.t: 2024 Constitutional Democratic Party of Japan presidential election
